name: Section+ - Classroom Management App

features_and_description:
Section+
is the ultimate offline command center built specifically for class presidents, secretaries, and student leaders. Streamline your daily classroom operations, ditch the messy paper records, and manage your entire section directly from your phone—no internet connection required.
Designed with privacy and speed in mind, Section+ keeps all your student rosters, financial data, and attendance records securely stored on your local device.
Key Features:
QR Code Attendance
: Generate unique QR codes for every learner. Scan them instantly to record daily attendance as present, late, or absent.
Class Ledger & Finances
: Keep a transparent record of class funds. Track paid contributions, monitor unpaid fines, and manage your section's balance directly from the dashboard.
Task & Schedule Management
: Assign and shuffle weekly cleaning duties effortlessly. Keep track of your daily class subjects and schedules in one convenient hub.
One-Tap PDF Exports
: Generate professional, printable PDF reports of your attendance history and class ledger to share with teachers or advisers.
100% Offline & Private: No Wi-Fi? No problem. Section+ operates completely off the grid, ensuring your classmates' data stays private, secure, and entirely under your control.

name: Hikari
tagline: Free Next.js starter for subscription applications
features_and_description: Hikari is a free Next.js starter, released under MIT, for developers building subscription applications with individual accounts. It includes Supabase authentication, Stripe recurring billing, a protected dashboard, and MDX docs and blog pages. Clone the public repository, run it locally, and customize the code for your product.

name: NomNom
tagline: We have no financial advice. Just meal ideas.
features_and_description: NomNom helps take the stress out of figuring out what to eat. With AI-powered meal tools, personalized meal planning, and photo-based food analysis, it helps turn everyday food decisions into more manageable choices—based on your goals, preferences, and lifestyle. Because we can’t fix your finances or give you more hours in a day, but we can help make figuring out your meals a little easier.

name: ChainDaan
tagline: Connecting Local Suppliers, Growing Local Businesses.
features_and_description:
ChainDaan is a digital platform designed to connect suppliers and local business owners in Ilocos Norte, making it easier for them to discover one another, communicate, and build lasting business relationships. It brings both sides of the local supply chain into one accessible space, helping business owners find potential sources for their needs while giving suppliers more opportunities to introduce their products and reach new customers.
For local business owners, finding the right supplier can take considerable time and effort, especially when information is scattered across social media, personal contacts, and recommendations. ChainDaan aims to simplify this process by providing a more direct connection to suppliers within the local community. Whether someone is starting a small business or looking for additional sources of supplies, the platform is designed to help them explore potential partners and begin conversations about their business requirements.
For suppliers, ChainDaan offers an opportunity to increase visibility and connect with business owners who may need their products. It aims to help local suppliers expand their reach beyond their existing networks and establish relationships with businesses across the province. By making these connections more accessible, the platform supports opportunities for both new and established suppliers to participate in the local market.
At its core, ChainDaan is about making business connections simpler and more meaningful. Its name reflects the idea of a “chain” that links suppliers and businesses, and a “daan,” or pathway, that opens opportunities for collaboration and growth. The platform’s goal is to reduce the difficulty of finding business partners and help turn local connections into productive, long-term partnerships.
Through this approach, ChainDaan aims to support a more connected local business community—one where suppliers can reach the right customers, business owners can find suitable partners, and both can grow together while contributing to the economy of Ilocos Norte.

name: Kamayan
tagline: Where hands meet and come to an understanding
features_and_description:
A prototype that recognizes user-taught ASL signs and translates them into English or Tagalog text, with optional speech features. It is not yet a general-purpose ASL translator.
Team members:
Maria Raychelle Palisoc
Sudip Shah
Ree Anne Sangahin
Public GitHub repository:
Repository
Proof / demo video:
X Post
What runs locally:
The FastAPI backend and its built-in translation rules can run on a local computer. Optional speech models and Ollama can also run locally when installed and configured.
What requires internet:
The first-time installation and model downloads require internet. A Render-hosted deployment also requires internet access. Ollama translation requires a separately running Ollama service.
Disclosures — models used:
Optional MMS text-to-speech models (facebook/mms-tts-tgl, facebook/mms-tts-eng) and faster-whisper for speech-to-text. Optional Ollama model: gemma2:2b by default. List any additional models used in the demo.
Technologies and frameworks:
Python, FastAPI, Docker, and Render. Add the frontend technologies if they’re part of the version you submit.
APIs and cloud services:
Render for hosting. Hugging Face model downloads on first use. Ollama is optional and must be hosted separately.
Existing code and assets:
The repository uses third-party Python libraries and pretrained speech models.
AI development tools:
VSCode Copilot, Claude
Why does this product benefit from running AI locally?
Local processing can keep camera and translation data on the user’s device, reduce network delay, and support use without a cloud AI service after setup. That can improve privacy and make the tool more accessible in low-connectivity settings. However, when deployed on Render, processing runs on the hosted server—not on the user’s device—so describe local processing only for the locally run version.

name: Gemce
tagline: Offline Study Assistant
features_and_description:
In many schools and review centers across the Philippines and worldwide, cellular reception is weak or non-existent, and mobile data is prohibitively expensive. When students need rapid exam review, concept clarification, or interactive practice, cloud-based AI tools simply fail to connect.
Gemce solves this by running an entire state-of-the-art Large Language Model (Gemma 4 E2B) directly on the student's Android smartphone.
Students import their own syllabus, lecture slides, textbooks, or handwritten review sheets (via camera OCR, PDF, DOCX, PPTX, Markdown, or text paste). Gemce normalizes the text into structured sections and transforms them into:
⚡ Flashcards with mathematically sound SM-2 Spaced Repetition.
🎯 Multiple-Choice Quizzes (MCQ) with instant scoring and rationales.
🧠 Interactive Tests with AI-evaluated short answers and student grade overrides.
📖 High-Yield Concept Reviewers with verbatim citation evidence.
💬 Ask Gemce & Contextual Chat with multi-session memory, section citations, and native Markdown rendering.
🌐 Multilingual Explanations in English, Filipino (Tagalog), Taglish, and Binisaya (Cebuano).

name: DIY Sounds - Speaker box calculator
tagline: Design a speaker box from your driver specs, free in the browser
features_and_description: Building a speaker or subwoofer box usually means manually calculating volumes and and panels, old desktop software like WinISD, and hand-drawn cut plans. DIY Sounds puts the whole job in one free web app. Enter your driver TS parameters, or pick one of 900+ manufacturer drivers from the built-in database. It then designs a sealed, ported or bandpass enclosure for it: box volume, port length, frequency response, impedance and a sound-field view. You can shape the cabinet in a 3D editor and export a cut list for the panels. An AI assistant answers questions about your own design. You can also publish designs to the community and browse what other builders have made. It's for car-audio and home-audio hobbyists, DIY speaker builders, and anyone who wants their box to actually hit the tuning they planned.

name: Pangaea: Idle Game
tagline: Compete & Collect
features_and_description: Pangaea: Idle Game is a simple idle game where you mine, collect, steal, destroy, and connect. Mine resources, discover rare Pocket Items, and build your collection. Use special cards to steal or destroy items from other players, or use Spell Cards to contact and message with them. Keep mining, find new items, protect your collection, and discover what other players can do. Play at your own pace and see how far your collection can grow.

name: Precy - Reading Companion
tagline: Track Pages, Learn Words
features_and_description:
Never lose your place again. Precy remembers where you stopped, gives you a quick recap, and keeps your quotes, words, notes, and reflections together.
Precy is a reading companion for keeping track of what you read and what you want to remember.
Stop reading? Drop a bookmark. Precy remembers where you left off and gives you a quick recap when you return, so you spend less time figuring out what happened and more time reading.

name: Stashi
tagline: Private Money Tracker.
features_and_description:
Stashi is a calm, private money tracker for your phone. Bring your cash, bank and digital accounts into one place, log what comes in and goes out, and see where your money is going.
EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
- Cash, bank and digital accounts, each with its own balance
- Transfers between your accounts that never count as income or spending
- Interest on an account, with quarterly crediting and a minimum balance to earn
TRACK EVERY EXPENSE
- Log income and expenses in seconds, with categories you can edit
- Search and filter your transactions
- Recurring bills, paydays and transfers, logged automatically on the days you pick, including twice a month
UNDERSTAND YOUR SPENDING
- This month's money in, money out and net, with a six-month chart
- The headline of what changed this month, in plain words
- Where your spending went, by category
- Transfers kept out of income and spending
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account to create, no sign-up, no email
- Your data is saved on this phone. Nothing goes to a Stashi server
- App lock with your fingerprint or screen lock, and Hide amounts for when someone is looking
- No bank connection: you enter what you want to track
- Export everything as CSV or JSON, and back up or restore your data any time
MADE TO FEEL GOOD
- Light and dark appearance
- Choose your currency
STASHI PRO (OPTIONAL ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
- Insights in full: every finding about your month, not just the headline
- Look back at any past month, with what moved and the full category breakdown
- Savings pockets inside a bank or e-wallet account, each earning its own interest, with an optional due date
- Reminders the day before each recurring charge
- Export what you filtered, or a whole month, as CSV
- Unlimited recurring expenses and categories (free includes 3 recurring expenses and 12 categories; recurring income and transfers are unlimited)
No ads.

name: PASKO PLANNER
tagline: Libreng Monito-Monita organizer. Private draws, wishlists, at instant sharing.
features_and_description:
Manual Monito-Monita or Secret Santa draws are usually a headache—requiring manual slips of paper, and often ruining the surprise. Pasko Planner solves this with a free, localized web app designed for Filipinos.
Simply create a group, set your budget and party date, add exclusions (like couples or siblings), and let the app handle the random draw.
What's Unique:
> ✅ Absolute privacy (even the organizer can't see the matches)
> ✅ Built-in anonymous chat and wishlists
> ✅ Shareable greeting card and Messenger integration
> ✅ Taglish UI, built specifically for the Philippine market
Currently in Beta, looking for feedback from the community!

name: Bernn
tagline: Cloud & API Spending in one app
features_and_description:
I know it's really really really cliche but dang does it hurt. I experienced that sh*ty time where you get a massive invoice from an API or Cloud Provider (Anthropic and OpenAI in my case) and you just can't believe you almost went into generational debt.
The problem is that AWS, Anthropic, and OpenAI each bill you separately, and none of them show you the combined total. You only find out how much you spent after it's too late to do anything about it.
That's why I built
Bernn
, and it's now live on the App Store.
What it does:
- One Dashboard: See your AWS, Anthropic, and OpenAI spend as one total in one app.
- Budget Alerts: Get a notification when you're about to pass your budget, before the bill arrives.
- Anomaly Detection: Get warned when your spend suddenly jumps above your usual average.
- Full Privacy & Security: Stay safe with read-only access, so Bernn can never change or spend anything on your accounts.
Do you need to manually input your spending?
NO
.
All you need is your API keys and Bernn will track them for you. There's even instructions in the app on how you can attach them.
UNLIMITED KEYS & TRACKERS FOR BERNN PRO.

name: Skwela
tagline: Enroll. Collect. Report.
features_and_description:
Private schools in the Philippines still run enrollment on paper forms, tuition on a cashier's notebook, and balances on a spreadsheet that never matches. Parents line up just to ask how much they still owe.
Skwela puts the whole school office in one system. The registrar enrolls a student in four steps, with requirements, guardians and the DepEd LRN. The cashier records tuition at the window, or approves proof of payment that parents send by GCash, Maya or bank, and every payment gets a receipt number. The school prints Form 137 (SF10), certificates and the Statement of Account, and sees Billed, Paid and Uncollected for the school year. Parents get a portal on their phone with their balance, installments and released grades, with nothing to install.
What makes it different: it's built around the words a Philippine school office already uses, each school gets its own Skwela with its own database, and every role (registrar, cashier, teacher, admin, parent) sees only its own work.

tagline: Your barkada's hangout, group chat, voice huts, and shared watch parties

Tambay (Filipino for "hangout spot")
is a group chat app built for the
barkada
— the Filipino friend group that scatters across Messenger, Discord, and Viber trying to find one place to just vibe.

tambayan

for calls and screen sharing, plus a buddy system for 1:1 DMs. On top of chat, Tambay adds the stuff that actually makes a hangout fun: react with emoji and stickers, send voice messages, drop sound effects on a shared soundboard, listen to music together with
MeowP3

It's free

Made by
Acqron
, a small Philippine dev shop, for the way Filipino friend groups actually talk to each other.

name: Room Riot
tagline: Turn any room into game night with hilarious party games for friends and family.
features_and_description:
Bring the family together. It’s time for a Room Riot.
Room Riot is a collection of party games designed for friends, families, reunions, get-togethers, and those nights when everyone just wants to have a good laugh.
Start a game, gather everyone in the room, and let players join using their phones. Then compete in trivia, guessing games, challenges, and other chaotic game-show-inspired rounds.
Whether you're playing with friends on a Friday night or turning a family gathering into a full-blown competition, Room Riot makes it easy to get everyone involved.
WHAT CAN YOU PLAY?
Room Riot features a growing collection of party games, including:
The games
• Family Trivia - Answer four-choice quiz questions on Filipino culture, history, showbiz, and more.
• What's Cooking? - Read four clues and pick the Filipino dish or drink, from home cooking and street food to regional specialties.
• Guess the Emoji - Emoji appear one at a time and spell out a word or name.
• Lantern - Hangman but let's make it Filipino. Take turns choosing letters to reveal a hidden Filipino phrase, such as a song title or a saying, before eight wrong guesses put the lantern out.
• Majority Rules! - Vote for the answer you think most of the room will pick. There is no right answer, only the most popular one.
• Stand Alone! - Pick the answer you think the fewest players will choose. The least-picked answer scores, with a bonus if you are the only one on it.
• Pass the Message - A hot-potato game: tap to pass the message on. Faster passes score more, and a hidden fuse knocks out whoever is holding it when time runs out.
• 1-2-3 Pass! - Everyone holds three food cards and passes one to the next player every three seconds. Collect three of a kind and call it first to win the deal.
PERFECT FOR
• Barkada nights
• Family gatherings
• House parties
• Reunions
• Team get-togethers
• Birthdays
• Game nights
• Anyone who gets way too competitive over trivia
FILIPINO FUN, PARTY-GAME CHAOS
Room Riot takes inspiration from the energy of classic game shows and modern party games, with its own Filipino personality.
Together the games hold nearly 4,000 questions, clues and phrases. Some categories are in optional question packs, described below.
How it works
• The host creates a room and invites players with the code or an invite link. A room holds up to 12 players, including the host.
• The host picks and starts each game. Everyone answers, votes and takes turns on their own screen.
• Every phone needs an internet connection, but not the same Wi-Fi, so someone in another city can join with the link. A player who drops out can rejoin the same way.
• In Family Trivia, What's Cooking? and Guess the Emoji, Kuya Q explains many of the answers after the reveal, and every player receives an end-of-game award.
• Every game ends with final standings and a winner, and the host can start a rematch with Play again.
New games, questions, and ways to play can be added over time, so every Room Riot doesn't have to feel the same.
Gather your players.
Pick a game.
Start the riot.

name: Uppetite
tagline: Food that fits your break
features_and_description:
Ever spent half your lunch break deciding where to eat?
For students at the University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB), finding a place to eat isn't always easy. With limited time between classes, dozens of food spots around Elbi, and the same question of *"Saan tayo kakain?"*, choosing where to go can take longer than expected.
Uppetite is a student-built, map-based food discovery web app that helps the UPLB community explore restaurants, cafés, and other food spots around Los Baños.
Instead of endlessly scrolling through recommendations or repeatedly visiting the same places, users can discover nearby food options through an interactive map and explore places that fit their schedule and preferences.
What makes UPPETITE different?
- 🗺️ Map-based discovery — Explore food spots around the UPLB community through an interactive map.
- 🍜 Discover more of Elbi — Find alternatives to your usual food spots and explore what the local food scene has to offer.
- 📍 Location-focused exploration— Discover places based on where they are, making it easier to decide where to eat.
- 💬 Community contributions — Suggest new places, report issues, and help keep food information useful for everyone.
Less searching. More eating. Food that fits your break.

name: Kivo
tagline: Everything important in one place
features_and_description:
OVERVIEW
Kivo is a local-first desktop application designed to help users organize and manage their notes, files, useful links, and personal information in one place. The application prioritizes local storage, giving users control over their data by keeping their device as the primary storage location.
MAIN FEATURES:
1. NOTES MANAGEMENT
- Rich-text editor for creating and editing notes.
- Automatic saving to prevent data loss.
- Version history for viewing and restoring previous versions of notes.
2. SOURCES AND FILE MANAGEMENT
- Save and organize useful website links.
- Import files into managed local storage.
- Preview supported file formats directly within the application.
3. ORGANIZATION
- Organize notes, files, and links into collections.
- Add tags for easier categorization.
- Mark important items as favorites.
- Recover accidentally deleted items from the trash.
4. SEARCH FUNCTIONALITY
- Search items using titles, details, and indexed content.
- Extract and index text from PDF documents.
- Support content searching while respecting encryption limitations.
5. PASSWORD MANAGER
- Securely store login credentials.
- Protect stored passwords using a separate master password.
- Lock the password manager to prevent unauthorized access.
6. DATA PROTECTION AND RECOVERY
- Optional field-level encryption for sensitive information.
- Create local backups of application data.
- Validate backups before restoring data.
- Export information in Markdown or JSON format.
7. LOCAL DISCOVERY AND SMART TOOLS
- Identify related notes and items automatically.
- Suggest relevant tags based on content.
- Generate short summaries using local text processing.
- Perform these operations directly on the user's device without relying on cloud-based language models.
CORE PURPOSE
Kivo aims to provide a private, organized, and centralized digital workspace where users can manage their personal information efficiently while maintaining control over their data through local-first storage.

name: G-Monitor Talkback
tagline: Live team talkback over local Wi-Fi, without internet.
features_and_description:
Keep your team connected during rehearsals, live events, and production work. G-Monitor Talkback turns Android devices into a local voice communication system using shared Wi-Fi or a transmitter’s hotspot.
Start a transmitter session, then let receivers join through QR codes, manual pairing, or network discovery. Talk to everyone or choose a specific teammate, with transmitter controls to approve joins and remove participants.
Toggle your microphone on or off while listening to your team. Optional background operation and compatible headset buttons help you communicate while your hands are busy.
No internet connection or cloud audio server is required during sessions.

name: HotSound

features_and_description: HotSound is a desktop soundboard for Windows. It shows a PC keyboard layout on screen; each key can hold a sound, and pressing that key plays it. It runs entirely on your own computer. There are no user accounts, no sign-in, and no server component.

name: BenhSQL
tagline: Run SQL against any database, from one tab
features_and_description:
BenhSQL
is a self-hosted SQL workbench for MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Write queries, see results as tables, JSON or charts, and ask an AI that can see your editor. One Node process, no build step.
Three databases
Save MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite connections. Upload a SQLite file and query it directly. Passwords are encrypted at rest.
Multi-query results
Run several statements at once. Each result gets its own tab, named after the table it came from.
Charts from results
Turn any result into a bar, line, pie, doughnut or scatter chart by picking the columns.
ER diagram
Open a draggable diagram of a database's tables and foreign keys, with pan and zoom.
AI that sees your query
Chat with a cloud model, your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or a GGUF model running inside the app. The editor and result are attached automatically.
Select and ask
Highlight SQL, then rewrite it in place, ask a quick question, or send it to the chat.
Convert to code
Turn a query into PHP or Node.js, or translate it between MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite and MSSQL.
Find and shortcuts
Search connections, history, tables and JSON. Save, open and comment with the keys you already know.
Yours to run
Data stays on your machine. Light and dark themes, history of every run, CSV and JSON export.

name: Patas
tagline: A fair meeting spot for your group, so nobody gets stuck with the long commute.
features_and_description:
Patas picks a meeting spot for a group so that nobody gets stuck with the long commute. It started with high school group projects, and it works the same for college groups, orgs and teams. Patas is Tagalog for "even" or "fair."
Each member picks a public landmark near where they'll start, like their school, an LRT/MRT station, a mall or their barangay hall. Patas shortlists about 20 venues (libraries, malls, cafés, fast food places) and gets each member's travel time to each one. It ranks them by the longest trip first, so the member with the worst commute is as well off as possible. Close calls go to the spot with the smallest gap between the longest and shortest trip. Each result shows everyone's minutes as dots on one scale, so you can see at a glance how fair a spot is.
One person can enter everyone's landmarks on a single phone. The group can also share a link and let each member add their own. Nobody sees anyone else's landmark, only who has joined and the results.
It was built for high school students, so Patas never asks for a home address and never stores an exact location. Each starting point is blurred to a cell about 200 m across. Group data is encrypted with a key the server never keeps, and it's deleted after 48 hours.
What works today: this is an early version, in testing. It covers Quezon City only, and members can start up to 5 km outside the city line. Travel times are driving times on clear roads, shown with a rough rush-hour range. Jeepney, UV and train times aren't in yet.
Data and services: map, landmark and venue data from OpenStreetMap. Travel times from openrouteservice. Page views are counted with GoatCounter, which uses no cookies. The app doesn't use AI.
Built with Next.js, React, Postgres (Neon), H3, and Leaflet with Protomaps tiles. Hosted on Vercel. Source code (MIT): https://github.com/alfieprojectsdev/patas

name: Agent Skills
tagline: Five reusable workflows that teach AI coding agents the work around code
features_and_description:
Coding with an AI agent is easy to start and hard to finish. Understanding an unfamiliar repository, implementing features correctly, debugging failures, designing frontend UIs, and setting up a project for agentic development are the work around writing code and most people do it with ad hoc, inconsistent prompts.
Agent Skills is a free, curated catalog of five installable workflows ("skills") that teach an AI coding agent how to perform this recurring work: understanding codebases, implementing features, debugging code, designing frontends, and setting up agentic projects. Each skill is portable Markdown with references, optional helper scripts, and ready-to-copy prompts, installable into Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenCode with a single command.
What makes it unique: the workflows are reusable and tool-agnostic instead of a random prompt dump, and the site documents exactly when to use each skill, gives practical use cases and prompts, and generates the correct installation command for your coding tool.

name: NanoSim
tagline: Shrink down and play with real nanoparticles, water molecules and cells.
features_and_description:
NanoSim is a free science simulation made in Caraga for students and teachers. You can see the nanoscale: zoom from a human hair down to single atoms, grow gold nanoparticles and watch the beaker turn ruby red, add salt and watch the particles clump and turn blue (the same colour change a rapid test uses), melt an ice crystal molecule by molecule, and design a nanoparticle that a living cell swallows.
Every number comes from real physics: Brownian motion, plasmon colour, quantum-dot size, the energy a cell membrane spends to wrap a particle. Pip, a cartoon gold nanoparticle, guides kids through 8 missions with badges. Teachers can switch the cartoons off for a standard lab.
No email or real name needed. No ads. Works on school Wi-Fi.

name: Walkie
tagline: Step Counter & Pet
features_and_description:
Walkie is a fitness and step counter app that turns everyday walking into a game.
Instead of just showing your step count, Walkie gives you reasons to keep moving. Your steps help you complete daily missions, maintain streaks, earn rewards, unlock achievements, collect cosmetics, and progress through different journeys.
You can also compete with friends through walking duels and leaderboards, compare your activity with other Walkie users, and track your progress with detailed walking and health stats.
At the center of the app is your virtual cat companion. You can customize him with different outfits, accessories, shoes, and other cosmetics you earn or collect.
Walkie is designed especially for people who want to be more active but don’t connect with traditional fitness apps. The goal is simple: make walking feel fun and rewarding instead of like a workout you have to do.

name: Waygo
tagline: Find your way. Go at your pace.
features_and_description: Waygo is an app that helps you keep up with recurring routines (like a morning checklist or weekly workout) and one-off reminders, treating them as two different things instead of mashing them into one to-do list. Its streak logic is forgiving, so a day with nothing scheduled or a day you deliberately skip doesn't wipe out your progress. It's intentionally small and private: no account, no AI, and all your data stays on your phone. You also get Home Screen widgets, optional Calendar and Reminders syncing, and Stats and History tabs to see how consistent you've been.

name: SummaScan: PDF Scanner & AI
tagline: Documents don't read themselves. We do.

name: Tanaw
tagline: See where it flooded, and what was built there
features_and_description:
Tanaw: See where it flooded, and what was built there.
🔗 tanaw.suriin.ph
Why I built it
Living in Pampanga, flooding is basically a yearly routine. In August 2026, the whole province was again declared under a State of Calamity. Typhoon Uwan in November 2025 flooded 72 barangays across nine towns and affected nearly 184,000 people (Source: PDRRMO, PIA). At this point the floodwater and I are on a first-name basis, so I got curious what it looks like around the flood control projects, and mapped it with some spare tokens and a few free nights.
What it does
Tanaw puts satellite-observed flooding, event by event, right next to public DPWH flood control project records. You can search any city, municipality, or barangay, filter flood events by date, and open any project to see its contract details as publicly reported.
How it works
Observations, not verdicts:
Tanaw shows what was observed, where, and when. It does not judge whether a project worked; flooding near a structure can have many causes unrelated to it.
Open method and data:
Every layer names its source, license, and the date it was measured.
Sources can disagree:
When two records list different locations for a project, both are shown.
Event-based flooding:
Floods are mapped per event and per date, never as a permanent condition.
Weekly updates:
Sources are re-checked weekly. A public API and full methodology page are available on the site.
Data sources
Flood extent:
PhilSA
satellite flood maps, via HDX (CC BY)
Projects: DPWH Transparency records, via
BetterGov's
snapshot
Second project locations:
DIME / DBM
Base map:
OpenStreetMap
, tiles by Protomaps
This isn't rocket science. All the data was already public. The hard work belongs to PhilSA, BetterGov, and everyone who made it open. Tanaw just puts it all on one map.
Coverage and roadmap
Currently live: Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, Pampanga, and Tarlac (4,105 projects mapped).
Coming next:
Zambales, Bataan, and Aurora, to complete Region III
Then Cagayan, Isabela, Pangasinan, Oriental Mindoro, Leyte, Occidental Mindoro, Zamboanga del Sur, Camarines Sur, Cotabato, and Ilocos Norte
Rollout order is based on how much flooding PhilSA observed near mapped flood control projects across all 97 recorded events from Aug 2022 to Sep 2026, covering 32,520 geocoded projects nationwide. It decides where to map first, not which projects are good or bad.

features_and_description:
Developer tools can quietly consume gigabytes of storage across projects, dependencies, build output, caches, and generated artifacts.
ExactDisk helps you understand where that space went — before deciding what to do about it.
Built specifically for macOS developers, ExactDisk scans only the folders you choose and maps developer storage back to projects and toolchains. It then classifies detected artifacts using deterministic, explainable rules.
UNDERSTAND YOUR DEVELOPER STORAGE
See developer storage from two perspectives:
• Projects — understand which projects are consuming space
• Ecosystems — see storage associated with Xcode, Node.js, Flutter/Dart, and Gradle development
KNOW THE RISK BEFORE RECLAIMING
Every detected artifact is classified as:
• Safe
• Rebuildable
• Review
• Never touch
ExactDisk explains why an item received its classification instead of presenting a generic list of files to delete.
SAFETY-FIRST RECLAIM
Scanning and planning are read-only.
Before reclaiming anything, ExactDisk performs fresh validation of the selected item, its location, permissions, project state, and other safety signals.
Eligible items are moved to macOS Trash — never silently permanently deleted.
If ExactDisk cannot confidently verify that an operation is safe, it blocks the reclaim instead.
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
ExactDisk is local-first and offline-capable.
• No account required
• No analytics
• No telemetry
• No cloud upload
• No source-code upload
• No external AI service required
Your project information and storage analysis stay on your Mac.
BUILT FOR DEVELOPERS
ExactDisk currently recognizes developer storage associated with Node.js, Flutter/Dart, Gradle, and project-linked Xcode DerivedData, with additional ecosystems planned for future releases.
Requires macOS 14 or later.

Easy-to-use visual communication cards

name: WorshipSavvy
tagline: Put the Word on the screen
features_and_description:
WorshipSavvy puts your whole service on screen — song lyrics, Bible passages, sermon points, and background media — from one simple control window. Built for the person running the booth on a Sunday morning, it stays out of your way so you can focus on the service, not the software.
ONE SCREEN TO RUN THE SERVICE
Build your order of service, then go live with a click. Switch instantly between the live slide, your church logo, a black screen, a clear background, or a countdown. Keyboard shortcuts (space to advance, arrows, L/B/C) keep your hands off the mouse during the service.
SONGS, DONE RIGHT
Add songs with lyrics, author, copyright and CCLI number — the title slide shows the credits automatically. Lyrics resize to fit the screen on their own, so long verses never get cut off, or switch to fixed line-per-slide splitting if you prefer. Import lyrics, tag verses and choruses, and arrange repeats however your team sings them.
SCRIPTURE BUILT IN
Ten Bible translations are included — search a reference or keywords and send a passage straight to the screen, verse by verse or packed to fit. No internet required.
SERMONS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS
Write sermon slides the fast way — type the whole message in one box and leave a blank line wherever a new slide should start — or lay them out slide by slide with private speaker notes that never appear on the projector. Add announcement banners and a service countdown for before the service begins.
A STAGE DISPLAY FOR YOUR TEAM
Give your worship team and pastor their own backstage view: what's on screen now, what's coming next, the speaker's notes, the schedule, and the countdown — all without turning around.
FOLLOW ALONG ON ANY PHONE OR TABLET
Everyone on the same Wi-Fi can open the live stage display right in their browser — just scan the on-screen code. No app to install, nothing to sign in to. It's view-only, so it's safe for anyone on the network, and it works great full-screen on a tablet at the front.
MEDIA AND THEMES
Bring in images and looping video for backgrounds or full-screen moments. Style your output with themes — fonts, colors, alignment, and backgrounds — and set defaults per content type so everything looks consistent.
WORKS THE WAY A SUNDAY DOES
WorshipSavvy drives a second display for the projector or TV and keeps it awake through the whole service. Plug and unplug the projector and the output follows along. Everything runs on your own machine — your songs, your schedule, your Bibles — with no account required and nothing phoning home.
A full-featured, one-time purchase. No subscription, no trial nag, no sign-in.

name: DEV/STATION

name: Sargo Pro

features_and_description: Sargo Pro is an offline-first management platform for billiard halls, pickleball courts, badminton facilities, and other sports venues. Manage tables and courts, reservations, sessions, tournaments, POS, billing, inventory, customers, and reports—all from one app.

name: LakbayBook

is one shared book for your whole trip. Plan the itinerary, split the costs, track flights and hotels, and travel together, all in one place instead of scattered chats, spreadsheets and screenshots.

Plan together: a day-by-day itinerary the whole crew can edit, with times that follow the local time zone.

name: clackwell

When it’s time to work, dock your cards and use the built-in Focus Dock. You can also control your currently playing media from the Media Dock and archive cards you want to keep.

name: eGuard
tagline: Set screen time, bedtime and app rules for your child, and know they're working.
features_and_description:
eGuard helps parents set up digital safety protections on their children's phones and tablets, then shows whether each one is actually working.
Most parental control apps tell you a setting was saved. eGuard waits until your child's device confirms it. If a setting fails, is turned off, or a device stops checking in, you'll know.
SET UP PROTECTION IN MINUTES
• Add your child, pick a profile (Protected, Balanced or Custom), and eGuard suggests settings for their age
• Pair your child's device with a one-time code
• eGuard applies each setting and checks it on the device
PROTECTIONS YOU CAN MANAGE
• Screen time: daily limits, with a separate weekend limit
• Bedtime: pause the device overnight, every day or on school nights
• Apps: age-rating limits, per-app daily limits and blocking
• App approval: your child asks, you approve or decline
• Content: age ratings for movies, TV and books
• Web filtering: block adult sites or allow only the sites you choose
• Downloads: require your approval to install apps
• Location: see where your child's device is now
• Notifications: keep the device quiet during bedtime
• Uninstall protection: stop eGuard from being removed without you
CONFIGURATION HEALTH
One score shows how well each child's devices are protected. It has 10 checks, one per protection, and every check is based on what the device reports. It measures settings, never your child's behavior.

About KiddoTasks:

We believe chores are more than tasks on a checklist. They are opportunities for children to learn responsibility, practice good habits, contribute to the family, and gradually learn how to take care of themselves and the things around them.
The points and rewards in KiddoTasks are simply tools to make that learning process more engaging and enjoyable. They give children something to work toward while helping them experience the connection between effort, responsibility, and achievement.
But the goal is bigger than earning points.

Parents remain an essential part of that journey. KiddoTasks is designed to support parents, not replace them—giving families a simple way to encourage meaningful conversations about responsibility, effort, and why everyday tasks matter.

name: Cutroom
tagline: Talking Video Editor
features_and_description:
Your talking video is fine. The 400 pauses in it are not.
Cutroom listens through the whole thing and marks every um, uh and long pause on the timeline, so you stop scrubbing around hunting for dead air. Then it cleans the voice and burns in captions. All of it on your iPhone, with nothing uploaded.
WHAT IT DOES
• Finds the ums, the uhs and the long pauses. Every cut can be restored if you want the moment kept
• Closes the silent gaps, so the pacing holds
• Cleans the voice: room noise, hum, harsh phone-mic audio
• Burns in captions that stay in sync after every cut
• Edits a multi-clip talking timeline, not just one file
• Undo anything, fifty steps back
• Free to import and edit. Pay only when you export
CAPTIONS
Captions are cut with the video, so they stay in step. Dynamic shows one to three centred words that light up with the speech. Classic holds longer phrases near the bottom. Three styles to pick from, Clean, Bold and Impact, the last sized for sound-off viewing, and three fills in white, black or yellow. Move the text up or down the frame, and regenerate it whenever the edit changes.
AUDIO
Phone audio cleaned two ways. Clear Natural lifts the room and the harshness off; Clear Studio goes further when the recording needs it. Or keep the original audio untouched.
EXPORT
Output in 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9 at 1080p and 30 fps, sized for Reels, Shorts, TikTok or YouTube. The finished file saves straight to your photo library.
GOOD FOR
Podcast episodes, YouTube videos, course recordings, interviews, voice-over takes, and anyone tired of hearing themselves say um.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your clips are never uploaded and there's no account to create. The caption model downloads once during setup. After that, editing and export run on your iPhone.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Import your clips.
2. Cutroom marks every pause and filler word.
3. Keep the moments you want.
4. Export the finished cut.
FREE VS CUTROOM PRO
Importing, editing and previewing are free, for as many clips as you like. Exporting the finished file needs Cutroom Pro, a weekly or yearly auto-renewable subscription. The plan, its length and the price are shown in the app before you buy.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

name: DIVE - Browser for Devs

features_and_description:

Dive is a Chromium browser built around that work. Each project gets a workspace with its own tabs and session. The start screen lists the dev servers already running on your machine, so port 3000 is one click, not a guess. The developer toolkit — network with bodies and WebSocket frames, console, storage, accessibility tree, a device simulator, request mocking and rewriting — sits beside the page instead of on top of it.
What's different is the agent. Dive has one built in that works in your tabs: it reads the page, clicks, types, fills forms, and reports what it found. Because it addresses elements by locator rather than coordinates, any run it does can be exported as a passing Playwright test. It also speaks MCP, so Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client can drive your real browser — signed into your real sessions — instead of a headless one.
Free, MIT licensed, macOS and Windows.

name: Receipt8
tagline: Generate Custom Receipt
features_and_description:
Receipt8 is an open-source, visual receipt-design tool built to take the repetitive, error-prone parts of thermal-printer development out of a developer's hands. Instead of hand-writing ESC/POS alignment math from scratch for every project, Receipt8 lets you lay a receipt out visually, text, columns, QR codes, barcodes, dividers, cuts and get back ready-to-run printing code in the language your stack already uses.
Powered by a single shared receipt model, Receipt8 drives a live paper preview and a set of language generators from the exact same data, so what you see on screen is guaranteed to match what prints. It currently ships generators for Python (python-escpos), Node.js (node-thermal-printer), PHP (mike42/escpos-php), C#, and raw ESC/POS bytes, with a drag-and-drop block editor, adjustable paper width and connection type, and JSON import/export for sharing or version-controlling a layout.
Designed to run entirely in the browser, Receipt8 keeps every receipt you design local by default, nothing is sent to a server just to preview or generate code, and your draft persists automatically on your own device. This gives developers full control over their layouts and printer credentials while working, with an optional PHP endpoint available for anyone who wants to print server-side.
As an open-source project, Receipt8 is built to grow with its community: adding a new target language is a single file, and the project welcomes contributions from anyone who prints receipts for a living and is tired of writing the same padding logic twice.
Developer: Edgar Jugado

gokards
Actually Remember What You Study
You've been there. You study for hours, feel ready, then blank out on the exam. Or you nail it, but two weeks later? Completely gone. That's not laziness—it's just how memory works. Unless you use the right technique.
There's a science called spaced repetition. It's not sexy, but it works. Show yourself a card right before you forget it, and your brain actually holds onto it. Do it right, and you remember for years, not days.
Here's the Problem
Making flashcards is tedious. You get a PDF or a chapter, and you're stuck manually typing out cards. Or you find a study app that makes you build everything from scratch. By the time you set up your deck, you've already lost motivation.
Spaced repetition apps exist, but they assume you already have cards ready. You don't.
We Fixed It
Dump your entire textbook chapter, lecture notes PDF, or even a picture of your notebook into Cards at the Back. The AI reads it, figures out what actually matters, and turns it into flashcards. Takes two minutes.
Then you study. The app knows when you're about to forget something and shows you that card again. You're always studying what you need to study right now. No manual scheduling. No guessing.
What You Can Do
Upload anything
(PDFs, Word docs, images, slides) and get a deck in seconds
Study with perfect timing
—the app knows when to quiz you
Generate practice quizzes
to test yourself before the real exam
Challenge your friends
and see who's actually studying
Stay completely anonymous
—no email, no account, no tracking (if you want)
The Deal
Free. All of it. No paywall, no premium tier hiding features.
No signup. Hit the app, upload your notes, start studying. Done.
Anonymous. Study as "Anonymous" or use your name—your choice. Your progress stays on your device unless you sync it. No data selling, no ads tracking you, no algorithm profiling what you study.
Made by students, for students. Built by someone who was tired of forgetting everything too. Every feature is something we actually wanted while studying.
Who Uses It
Students prepping for tests (AP, SAT, ACT, board exams), language learners, anyone who's tired of forgetting everything they study.
Why This Actually Works
Spaced repetition is backed by neuroscience. Your brain is wired to hold onto information you review at the right time. This app just handles the timing for you so you can focus on learning.
Ready to remember what you study? No signup needed. Start now.

name: NEON STRIKE
tagline: Fast-Paced Top-Down Arena Shooter & Multiplayer Race Game
features_and_description:

is a modern browser-based arena shooter built around fast movement, escalating enemy waves, and score-chasing combat. Players pilot customizable ships through procedurally seeded battlefields, survive increasingly difficult waves, chain kills into combo multipliers, collect temporary buffs, and defeat boss enemies that appear throughout the run. The game supports solo play, offline play with local leaderboards, and Firebase-powered multiplayer race rooms where pilots compete by reaching the highest score in the same seeded challenge. The gameplay engine is separated from the Vue interface and runs as a deterministic fixed 60 Hz simulation. Canvas handles the high-frequency arena rendering while Vue manages the HUD, menus, overlays, settings, profiles, rooms, standings, and social features. The game includes responsive mouse, keyboard, and touch controls, a minimap, screen shake, synthesized Web Audio effects, pause handling, mobile support, light and dark themes, and performance-conscious rendering with particle limits and canvas scaling.

name: AuDHD
tagline: Gabay sa Autism at ADHD
features_and_description:
AuDHD is a calm, offline companion for parents raising a child with autism or ADHD. It turns the everyday work of parenting into something you can see, keep, and share with your child's doctor.
Everything stays on your phone. There is no account to create, no server, no ads, and no analytics.
A DAY YOUR CHILD CAN SEE
Build a picture schedule from morning to evening. Each finished task earns a star, and the stars add up to rewards that you choose yourself. Children who struggle with transitions can look at the next step instead of being told about it.
THINGS TO DO AT HOME
Dozens of activities using what you already own: clothespins, tape, a towel, a spoon. Each one lists how long it takes and which sense it works on, so you can pick what fits the mood of the day.
MILESTONES THAT FOLLOW YOUR CHILD
Track growth against age-appropriate developmental milestones. Nothing is scored or graded. It is a record of what your child can do, kept in one place.
BEHAVIOR YOU CAN EXPLAIN
Note what happened before, what your child did, and what happened after. Over weeks, patterns appear that are hard to notice day to day.
A SENSORY PROFILE
A checklist that shows whether your child seeks or avoids each kind of sensation, with practical suggestions for each result.
A REPORT FOR THE DOCTOR
One tap builds a PDF covering mood, behavior, sensory profile and routine over the last 30, 60 or 90 days. Share it or print it. Appointments are short. Walking in with a written record changes the conversation.
FOR THE PARENT TOO
Short notes to help you understand what your child is doing and why, plus small reminders that you need looking after as well.
PRIVACY
AuDHD works with no internet connection. Your child's name, photo, and records never leave your phone. You can delete everything at any time.
IMPORTANT
AuDHD is an observation tool for use at home. It is not a diagnosis and it does not replace a professional assessment. It cannot tell you whether your child has autism or ADHD. Please consult a licensed developmental pediatrician. Milestone content is based on publicly available CDC developmental milestones.

name: Pragma
tagline: A desktop app where every chat is a real AI agent, running on your own machine.
features_and_description:
REGISTER HERE - https://www.trypragma.xyz/alpha
Pragma is a free, local alternative to Grok Bot.
ANYONE CAN DOWNLOAD this for free but not everyone can commit to being an alpha tester, so please send me a message if you are IN.
I'm looking for alpha testers for Pragma: a desktop app where your AI agents sit in your contacts, and you message them like teammates.
Each agent has a name, a job, its own AI model and its own computer to work on. Talk to one directly, or put a few in a channel and hand out the work.
What makes it different:
• It runs on your PC. Your chats and keys are kept on your machine, not on our servers.
• It uses the AI you already pay for: Claude, ChatGPT and others, signed in with your own accounts. No subscription? It can run a free model on your graphics card.
• Nothing happens without your yes. Before an agent runs a command, changes a file or sends anything, it asks.
What alpha testers get:
• Pragma free while it's in alpha
• A free licence to keep when Pragma starts charging
• A direct line to me. Report a problem from inside the app, screenshot and all, and it comes straight to me
• Fixes without reinstalling. Pragma updates itself
• A real say in what I build next, and more benefits to come.
• Possibly a benefit related to money for helping me build it through testings and feedbacks.
ANYONE CAN DOWNLOAD but not everyone can commit to being an alpha tester, so please send me a message if you are IN.
What I'm asking for:
• A Windows PC (Mac and Linux are next)
• A Claude or ChatGPT subscription, or a graphics card with 8 GB of memory to run a free model
• Real work to try it on, and honest notes on what worked, what broke and what confused you
Fair warning: it's early. Expect rough edges, and a Windows "unknown publisher" warning when you install. The installer isn't signed yet.
Want in? Just download it directly, register your email, and you will be added as an Alpha user.
Why Pragma and not Grok Bot?
It runs on your PC, and your chats are saved there, not in xAI's cloud.
It isn't tied to one AI company. It runs on Claude, ChatGPT (through Codex), Grok itself, Qwen, or a free model on your own graphics card.
It's free while it's early. Grok Bot needs a SuperGrok or Cursor subscription.
It asks before every action. Grok Bot works on its own and only checks in when it needs approval. Some people want that level of control.
Where Grok Bot is ahead (worth knowing so the comparison holds up):

name: Blyp
tagline: Record once. Clicks become the edit, notes write themselves. Send a link.
features_and_description:
Blyp is a screen recorder for the things you would otherwise explain in writing: a product demo, a walkthrough for a new hire, a bug report for an engineer, an async update for the team.
The problem.
Screen recordings are either raw and hard to follow, or they need an editor and a render before anyone sees them. So people write three paragraphs instead, and the person reading them still cannot see what happened.
The solution.
Record one pass with your screen, camera and voice. With the Chrome extension, every click you make becomes a zoom and your pointer is redrawn smooth, so the plain take comes out looking edited. Stop, and the link is ready: it plays in any browser, no account needed, with captions, comments and emoji reactions.
What is different.
The edit is not burned into the video. It is a few kilobytes of JSON kept beside the file and applied when the video plays. So you can trim a false start, cut a stretch, move a zoom, hide a password or reframe your camera months later, and the link you already sent updates instantly with nothing re-rendered. You see who watched and how far they got. Revoke a link and it stops within seconds. A take even survives the browser closing mid-recording.
The notes write themselves.
Once a Blyp has captions, a model reads the transcript and writes a summary, the steps you showed, each bug with steps to reproduce and expected versus actual, and the action items with whoever you named. Every line links to its moment in the video. Bugs and action items are checkboxes, and the ticks are shared with everyone who has the link, so a bug report becomes a small tracker. You can correct or remove any line, add your own, and copy the whole list as Markdown into an issue. The zooms and the edit are arithmetic, not AI; the notes are the one place a model is used, and they say so.

tagline: Run Valorant map vetoes, agent drafts, side picks, and bans in real time.
features_and_description:
Draftix is a free competitive drafting platform built for Valorant teams, scrims, communities, and tournament organizers.
Instead of coordinating map bans and agent drafts through chat or spreadsheets, Draftix gives both teams a shared interactive room where picks and bans happen live.
With Draftix, you can:
Run live Valorant map vetoes
Draft and ban agents
Choose starting sides
Create shareable draft rooms
Use structured pick-and-ban flows for scrims and tournaments
Keep both teams synchronized in real time
Draftix is designed to make pre-match setup faster, clearer, and more professional for competitive Valorant players and organizers.
No installation is required — create a room, share the link, and start drafting.

name: MDMV Director
tagline: Creators
features_and_description:
MDMV Director is a multi-device production ecosystem built for creators who want to do more with fewer people and less equipment.
Instead of treating every phone, camera, microphone, computer, and screen as a separate device, MDMV brings them together under one Director.
A creator can use multiple phones as wireless cameras, bring in microphones and other video sources, monitor them from one place, control the production, record content, manage audio, and ultimately distribute the finished program—all from the same ecosystem.
Think of it as:
Your devices → Your production network → One Director.
With the MDMV ecosystem, we're building toward creators being able to:
📱 Turn phones into camera nodes — use Android and eventually iPhone devices as additional production cameras.
🎥 Bring different cameras together — phones, webcams, DSLR/mirrorless cameras, action cameras, 360° cameras and network/IP cameras through supported nodes and integrations.
🎙️ Build a multi-microphone setup — manage microphones and audio sources centrally through the MDMV Audio Engine.
💻 Use computers as production nodes — the Companion Node expands the Director to Windows PCs and other computers for cameras, microphones, screens, media and connected hardware.
🎬 Direct everything from one interface — preview sources, switch cameras, manage devices, control recording and oversee the production.
🖥️ Capture more than cameras — computer screens, presentations, prerecorded video, images, graphics and other production sources can become part of the show.
📺 Extend the production to other displays — MDMV TV Pairing™ and the Adaptive Viewer™ are designed to make phones, tablets, computers and TVs part of the viewing ecosystem.
🌐 Keep devices connected intelligently — MDMV Adaptive Connect™ and MDMV Bonded Connect™ are being developed around resilient multi-network production.
🤖 Add AI assistance — the longer-term AI layer is designed to help with camera decisions, audio, production recommendations, diagnostics and eventually automated directing.
🔌 Expand MDMV with plugins — the plugin ecosystem is intended to let MDMV grow beyond the features shipped by the core team, with compatible tools and integrations built by other developers.
So whether you're a YouTuber, podcaster, livestreamer, filmmaker, musician, dancer, educator, business presenter or solo creator, the idea is simple:
You shouldn't need a television studio to produce like you have one.
You may already have much of the hardware in your pocket, on your desk, or sitting unused in a drawer.
MDMV Director is being built to make all of it work together.
One Director. Multiple devices. One production ecosystem.

name: Tapik
tagline: Log  your games. Watch your rating move.
features_and_description: Tapik is an all-in-one pickleball community platform that helps players find courts, host and join matches, request bookings, track results, climb local rankings, and earn awards. For court owners, Tapik brings bookings, open-play sessions, tournaments, staff, and venue activity together in one simple workspace—connecting everything that happens on and around the court.

name: Zodipals
tagline: Your Cosmic Financial Companion
features_and_description:
Managing shared finances with friends, roommates, and travel groups often leads to friction, awkward reminders, and clunky spreadsheets. Zodipals is a modern social finance platform built to remove that stress entirely, combining robust expense management tools with engaging astrological insights. The app operates on an offline-first architecture, allowing you to log transactions, manage shared tabs, and check your balances anywhere—even without cellular data or an internet connection—with seamless cloud synchronization the moment you are back online.
The platform provides dedicated tools for every shared financial scenario. You can manage structured peer-to-peer loans with custom repayment intervals, optional interest, and transparent audit logs to ensure total clarity between friends. Group travel tabs and shared dining bills are calculated in real time, utilizing an optimization algorithm that minimizes the total number of transactions needed to settle debts. For shared households, recurring expenses like rent, power, and internet can be split evenly or with custom ratios to keep monthly payments on schedule.
Beyond group expenses, Zodipals functions as a comprehensive personal financial tracker. You can aggregate checking accounts, cash, and digital wallets into a single synchronized dashboard that displays your exact safe-to-spend runway before the next payday. Your experience is complemented by dynamic zodiac-based financial companions that offer spending awareness, cash flow tips, and friendly nudges aligned with your habits.
Privacy and accessibility sit at the core of the platform. Zodipals does not require linked bank passwords, and each group circle remains completely isolated, ensuring that personal loans, household ledgers, and vacation budgets stay strictly separate. Available as a lightweight progressive web app across mobile and desktop devices, Zodipals offers full functionality with zero paywalls, transaction limits, or app store download requirements.

name: MyFinTools
tagline: Ledger, payroll, invoicing & more — all local, no signup, zero cloud.

Freelancers and small business owners often end up juggling five different apps just to run their finances one for invoicing, another for payroll, a spreadsheet for bookkeeping, and yet another for POS sales. MyFinTools brings all of that into a single, all-in-one suite:

name: Puyo
tagline: Your Paluwagan, finally organized.

No more spreadsheets or "whose turn is it?" group chats. Puyo lets you:
✅ Set up your group — amount, schedule, members, payout order

name: CIReason
tagline: Know why your CI failed.
features_and_description:
CIReason helps developers understand why their CI pipeline failed without digging through hundreds of lines of logs.
It connects to GitHub Actions, monitors selected repositories, analyzes failed workflow logs with AI, identifies the likely root cause, and provides actionable information such as the failing step, likely trigger, affected area, error type, confidence, and suggested fixes.

tagline: A neon block puzzle with six modes, combos, and memory-driven challenges

Drag colorful blocks onto the board to clear lines, build combos, and beat your best score across six modes: Classic, Blitz, Puzzle, Triangle, Memory, and Mem Blitz. name: Rebyu: Philippine Constitution
tagline: Study the 1987 Philippine Constitution with practice, progress, and offline AI.
features_and_description:
Studying the 1987 Philippine Constitution can be difficult when the material is dense and practice resources are scattered. Rebyu helps students and exam candidates read, review, and retain the Constitution through a focused study workflow.
Users can browse and search constitutional articles, filter by topic, adjust text size, highlight passages, and create article-specific notes. They can also practice with flashcards, take timed mock exams in Quick Test, Standard, or Full Exam modes, bookmark questions, review mistakes, and track accuracy, streaks, exam history, and progress.
Its strongest differentiator is REMI, an optional offline AI study mentor that answers questions using constitutional content after its model is downloaded. Core study and testing features are free, with banner advertising. The app includes links to the Official Gazette as its source of constitutional information and stores study progress locally. name: Shadow Cat
tagline: Memorize the grid, dodge lasers, and catch every fish.
features_and_description:
Players looking for a focused, replayable challenge must remember safe routes while navigating hazards under pressure. Shadow Cat helps puzzle and casual game players sharpen memory, timing, and spatial awareness through a stealth-inspired grid game.
Study the grid while fish and laser positions are visible, then enter the blackout phase and navigate using swipe gestures or an on-screen directional pad. Collect every fish to complete the level, avoid laser hazards, and progress through increasingly challenging missions.
Shadow Cat offers three implemented modes: Classic for unlimited memorization time, Blitz for timed memorization challenges with 3-, 5-, and 10-second options, and Greedy for collecting multiple fish in one run. The game includes animated neon visuals, background music, sound effects, vibration feedback, persistent local progress, and adjustable audio and vibration settings.
The core game is free to play and includes banner advertising through Google Mobile Ads. There are no accounts, subscriptions, in-app purchases, or cloud-synced features implemented.

name: PSGC Cloud
tagline: A free Philippine geography API for developers and AI tools.
features_and_description:
Developers, researchers, web designers, and institutions often struggle to turn Philippine Standard Geographic Code data into clean, dependable application data. PSGC Cloud provides a free, public REST API for querying Philippine regions, provinces, cities, municipalities, sub-municipalities, and barangays in structured JSON.
The service supports versioned API documentation for v1 and v2, direct resource lookups, nested hierarchy traversal, ancestry validation, predictable fields, cached responses, and lightweight read-only endpoints. Developers can use standard HTTP clients, with examples for cURL, JavaScript fetch, Axios, and PHP Guzzle.
PSGC Cloud also includes a live Model Context Protocol server with geographic query tools for AI clients and coding environments, including Claude Desktop, Cursor, Antigravity IDE, and VS Code extensions such as Cline and Roo-Code. The API is community-provided and mirrors PSGC geographic structures; critical boundaries should be independently verified.

name: PowerSakto

name: at8pm
tagline: Your honest journal.

name: Luto: Recipe Kitchen

Cook with what you have. Plan your week. Build smarter grocery lists. Luto brings your kitchen together in one beautiful app, inspired by Filipino home cooking.
COOK WITH WHAT YOU HAVE

name: Saturn - Offline Reminders

BE REMINDED YOUR WAY • A week before, the day before, on the day — any combination • Daily, weekly, monthly, yearly repeats, and everything in between • Mark done or snooze right from the notification
STAY ON TOP OF LIFE • Finance, medicine, plans, and everyday reminders — color-coded • Overdue badge on the app icon, gentle nudges everywhere else • Insights: your completion rate, streak, and two-week activity — computed on your device, for your eyes only

name: Deckster
tagline: Quiz night for the room you are in. No internet, no signup — just a hotspot.
features_and_description:
Getting a group to play a quiz together usually depends on the one thing a room often doesn't have: a working connection for every phone in it. A code read out twice, a link in the group chat, an account each, somebody's data running out halfway through. In a classroom with no Wi-Fi, it never starts at all.
Deckster removes the requirement. One phone turns on its hotspot and becomes the server; every other phone connects to it, and the same question appears on all of them at once, on a shared clock. The 4,468 questions ship inside the app, so nothing is ever fetched. There is no backend — nothing is uploaded, because there is nowhere to upload it to.
What makes it unusual is what falls out of that. Joining is just connecting to a hotspot, so there are no codes, links or addresses to type by anyone. A teacher's questions and answers never leave their phone. And a player's device is only ever sent a projection of the game state, which makes it structurally incapable of receiving an answer before the reveal — not a rule someone has to remember, but a shape the data cannot take.
A moderated mode hands one person the round without putting them in it. Each question pauses twice: once when answers lock, so the room can argue before it finds out, and again for the reveal.

name: Robols Math
tagline: Practice. Improve. Compete
features_and_description:
Competition Maths
practice usually means a PDF of problems and an answer key. Nothing tells you whether a problem was genuinely hard or whether you are improving, difficulty is one author's guess, and the moment you go looking for a hint the solution spoils the problem.
Robols Math is a rated archive for mathletes and enthusiasts. Every problem carries a rating on the same scale you do, both starting at 1000. Taking one on is a single game between you and the problem: beat a problem above your rating and you climb meaningfully, lose to one well below you and it costs a great deal. Ratings and XP are recalibrated daily.
What makes it different:
Difficulty is measured, not asserted
. A problem's rating blends the problem setter's estimate, how solvers actually fared on it, and difficulty votes from the people who beat it.
Four leaderboards, not one
. Rating, XP, problems solved and contributions are ranked separately, so giving back to the archive counts as its own kind of standing. Any row puts your record side by side with that solver's.
Discussion opens only once you have finished
. Solve a problem or give up on it and the thread unlocks, so nobody can spoil it for you.
The archive is built by the people using it.
Anyone can propose a problem. Accepted ones are credited to their author, and the proposer's own solution becomes the first comment.
Warm-ups that cost nothing
. Practice problems earn XP but leave your rating untouched, so you can drill fundamentals without risk.
Badges you earn rather than collect
. Twenty-six of them, worked out from your solving record rather than granted, so a badge always matches the numbers beside it.
Over 500 problems across nine categories, with proper LaTeX and diagrams. The archive grows daily and we expect to have at least a thousand problems by end of 2026.
Website is free, nothing to install, works on a phone.

features_and_description:
Why bother tracking your money if you never do anything with it?
Most apps make logging a chore, then hand you a pie chart. Arok makes logging almost free — and then lets you actually dig into what you tracked.
Logging is one line
Type "250 lunch gcash" and it's done. Or type your whole day at once — "1200 groceries sm, 80 jeep, 350 dinner jollibee" — and it drafts each one separately. It understands shorthand, nicknames, and however you happen to phrase it. Every draft opens in the normal entry sheet, so you can tap through the account, category, date or amount before saving — type it, tap it, or both.
Then ask it anything
Not preset reports. Real questions, in your own words:
"How much did I spend on food last month?"
"What am I paying for every month?"
"Can I afford this before payday?"
Arok's AI assistant doesn't guess from a summary — it writes a real query and runs it against your records, the way an analyst would. So you can ask things nobody built a chart for.
You can check every answer
It shows you the exact query it ran and the data it got back. When it's inferring instead of reading, it says so. When it can't tell which account you meant, it asks. And if an answer matters, one tap makes a stronger model check it again.
It doesn't just answer. It does things.
Ask it to fix six months of wrong categories and it retags them. Ask it to clean up your messy category list and it plans it out. Snap your payslip and it reads your basic pay, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG and tax, line by line. You see the full list first — nothing saves until you confirm.
Tested, not hoped for
Every mistake the AI has ever made became a permanent test it has to keep passing. We also check that it never claims something it didn't actually look up.
A proper money tracker underneath
Accounts and transfers. Bills with real deadlines. Credit card cycles and what's actually due. Interest, cashback, cash flow forecasts, net worth over time. Import and export anytime.
Free, and yours alone
Free to use, open source, no sign-up. Everything stays on your phone — no server, no account. The AI is off until you turn it on, and there are free models to run it with.

features_and_description:

The Prompt Enhancement Engine is its core capability — a deterministic, browser-local system that analyzes a user's raw text and generates a well-organized prompt without requiring a backend service.
Structured Slot Extraction
Identifies an opening action, a subject phrase, mentioned technologies from an explicit allow-list, preservation constraints, and bulleted or implied requirements from raw text.
Smart Section Selection
Drops list-based sections when the corresponding extracted slot is empty, so a prompt without constraints does not generate an empty heading, while narrative sections receive default content downstream.
24 Reusable Sections with Three Strengths
Light returns a single polished sentence, standard adds requirements and verification, and detailed expands to a full structured document. The exact section order is owned by the template and validated as order-preserving subsets.
Light Polish and Grammar Correction
Rewrites a prompt into a single clear sentence that honors constraints and preserves intent, with a separate grammar-only mode when no sections are selected.

features_and_description:
Wulver turns bodyweight fitness into a streak game. Answer three questions and AI builds you a plan, then a wolf coach demonstrates every exercise while streaks, XP and ranks (Pup to Alpha) make tomorrow's workout the one you don't want to skip.

name: Aero
tagline: Know your toll. Plan your drive.
features_and_description:
Aero is a Philippine expressway driving companion built to make every road trip easier to plan. Estimate toll fees across supported expressway routes, compare Autosweep and Easytrip costs, choose your vehicle class, and check Skyway or at-grade route options before leaving.

name: PocketDocs
tagline: PDF, document, and image tools — no uploads, no accounts.
features_and_description:
PocketDocs is a private, browser-based toolkit for working with PDFs, documents, and images. Merge and split PDFs, compress files, convert formats, resize images, and handle everyday document tasks without uploading your files anywhere.

PocketDocs is designed to make everyday file tasks fast and simple, without subscriptions, unnecessary sign-ups, or sending sensitive documents to a remote server.

name: LaraShipped

name: Casa PH
tagline: Home Search, Simplified
features_and_description:
Casa PH is a Filipino-built real estate search platform designed for the Philippine market.

Our goal is to build a proper Filipino real estate platform — built for our market, affordable for local professionals, and something we can genuinely be proud of.

KeyChain Generator is a web-based design tool for creating customizable, 3D-print-ready keychain designs. It allows users to quickly generate personalized keychains by entering names or text and customizing the appearance of the design.

name: Basket Buddy
tagline: financial
features_and_description:
Basket Buddy is a smart grocery companion designed to take the stress out of shopping runs. It helps you stay within budget in real-time, track price trends across stores, and keep your shopping organized—all without complicated spreadsheets or checkout price shocks.
The Problem: Grocery shopping often leads to budget overspending because calculating total costs while navigating aisles is frustrating, and store prices constantly change without warning.
The Solution: Basket Buddy lets you set a budget before you start, scan items as you place them in your cart, and see your remaining spending balance update live.
What Makes It Unique: It combines instant barcode lookup, real-time basket balance tracking, store price history logs, and cloud sync in a clean, user-friendly interface.

name: UkayTrack
tagline: online, live seller
features_and_description:
Mahirap mag-manage ng live selling kapag solo seller ka—kalat ang papel na listahan ng Mine, malito sa puhunan at net profit, at mahirap mag-ipon ng totoong sahod para sa sarili.

Supplier Finder & Backup System: Direct access sa wholesale supplier links (Divisoria, Taytay, online) at easy JSON export/import para ligtas ang records mo.

name: TwinUp
tagline: Drop it. Chain it. Pop it. — chase the multiplier high.
features_and_description:
Most merge games never let you lose. TwinUp wants to see you try.
Drop a tile, chain your matches, and watch your score explode—but don't get comfortable. The board is actively working against you. Random blockages eat into your grid every single round, punishing bad placements and forcing you to think fast.
Drop & Chain: Tap a column to drop tiles and trigger massive multi-directional chain reactions.
Ride the Multiplier: Chain enough merges and watch your score go nuclear (1x → 2x → 4x → 8x...).
Detonate the Board: Hit the pop threshold to wipe the grid, cash in massive bonuses, and push into harder, higher-stakes rounds.
Built for the phone-in-one-hand crowd who actually wants a challenge. No hand-holding. No endless coasting. Just real stakes from the very first drop.

name: ganap.net
tagline: Payments Made Simple.
features_and_description:
GANAP.net is a Philippine-built digital platform that helps startups, MSMEs, creators, communities, and businesses accept payments, sell online, and launch faster.
Through GANAP.net, users can create storefronts for products, services, and events, accept payments through QRPh and cards, manage transactions, and access tools designed to make digital commerce simpler—without the complexity of building everything from scratch.
Built with early-stage businesses in mind, GANAP.net lowers the barrier to getting started so entrepreneurs can focus on one thing: turning ideas into actual transactions.
Tara. Collab. GANAP!

name: KLIPLY

features_and_description:

is an all in one link management platform for creators, businesses, teams, and organizations. It helps users turn long URLs into clean short links, customizable QR codes, and simple link pages, with real time analytics to understand how their links are being used.
PROBLEM
Link management tools are becoming expensive and complicated, with basic features like custom QR codes, link customization, and analytics often locked behind paid plans. This makes simple link management unnecessarily costly for individuals, communities, and small teams.
SOLUTION
KLIPLY
brings link shortening, branded QR codes, mobile friendly link pages, and real time analytics into one simple platform. It provides the essential tools with generous limits and affordable pricing, making link management more accessible to individuals and organizations.

Instant and Anonymous Link Shortening

Custom QR Code Generator

Mobile Friendly Link Pages
