name: Spendly
tagline: Scan groceries, track spending, and keep your budget on track.
features_and_description:
Spendly is an Android budgeting app designed to help people monitor their everyday spending and avoid mismanaging their budget—especially when buying groceries.
Create a grocery session with a budget, scan a readable handwritten list into a checklist, and scan price tags to quickly add items and prices while shopping. When a scanned item matches your checklist, Spendly can automatically mark it as completed. You can also scan a readable receipt to record a completed grocery session.
Spendly keeps your grocery history, product prices, and store comparisons in one place. It also supports bill and product-expiration reminders, with the option to scan a clear photo to fill in the form or enter the details manually.
Spendly is currently in closed alpha on Android, and I’m looking for testers who can share honest feedback and suggestions.

name: Flexr
tagline: Flex your game stats on a live map, see exactly who you're beating around you.
features_and_description:
Flexr turns the ranks you already grind into a flex.
Connect the games you play — Steam, osu!, chess, AniList and more — and Flexr pulls your stats into one profile, then ranks you on a live map: local, national, and global. See exactly who you're beating around you, in your city, and worldwide.
There are built-in games too (Tetris, 2048, Sudoku, Block Blast, Speed Math), so anyone can jump in and start climbing.
The part nobody else does: it's location-based. Your rank isn't just a number on a forum — it's who you outrank on the real map around you.
Free, with an optional premium for cosmetics and perks.

name: Sakada PH
tagline: See who has water before you go.
features_and_description:
Finding water in the Philippines often means guessing — calling around or driving to two or three refilling stations before finding one that isn't out of stock. Sakada PH fixes that by putting supplier stock status on a live map, so consumers can check before they leave the house.
Consumers browse nearby water suppliers on an interactive Leaflet map, filter by pickup, delivery, or distance, and follow their favorite stores to get notified the instant stock is restocked. Sellers get a lightweight dashboard to manage their store profile and toggle product availability in real time. Admins moderate the platform through an approval-gated onboarding flow, keeping listings trustworthy.
What makes it different from a generic directory listing is the live stock layer — color-coded map markers and follow-based restock alerts turn a static "here's a water station" list into something consumers actually check before making a trip, solving a small but genuinely annoying daily problem for Filipino households.

name: Tabby — Your Cozy Bookmark Buddy
tagline: A playful, cat-themed bookmark manager that keeps your tabs purring.
features_and_description:
Tabby is a lightweight Chrome extension designed to bring order to your bookmark chaos. Most people accumulate hundreds of bookmarks over time with no real system — scattered across folders, full of duplicates, and nearly impossible to navigate. Tabby solves that with a clean, playful interface that makes managing bookmarks feel effortless instead of overwhelming.
With Tabby, you can browse your bookmarks through a simple folder tree, search across your entire collection instantly, and reorganize everything with drag and drop — all from a popup that opens right in your browser. No new tabs, no complex setup, no learning curve.
Tabby connects directly to Chrome's native bookmark system, so everything stays in sync in real time. Any changes you make in Tabby reflect immediately in your browser, and vice versa. It also includes a duplicate detection feature to help you keep your collection clean and clutter-free.
Designed to be fast, minimal, and a little fun, Tabby is built for anyone who lives in their browser and wants their bookmarks to actually work for them — whether you're a developer saving resources, a student organizing research, or just someone tired of bookmark chaos.

name: PrintChum
tagline: Your companion for print-ready photos.
features_and_description:
PrintChum
is a privacy-first web application for creating accurate, print-ready ID photo layouts. A user can select local photos, crop them once, assign multiple physical sizes and quantities, arrange the results across standard or custom paper, preview every page, and print or download the layout as a PDF.
Customer photos remain in browser memory during the active session. They are not uploaded or permanently stored by the current application.
Current capabilities
Local JPEG, PNG, and WebP photo selection
Multiple people in one layout
Reusable normalized crop, zoom, and rotation settings
Standard and custom photo sizes with independent quantities
Letter / Short Bond, Legal (8 × 13 inches), A4, A3, 4R, 5R, and custom paper
Portrait and landscape paper orientation
Configurable margins and horizontal and vertical spacing
Deterministic mixed-size placement and automatic page overflow
Optional cutting guides, size labels, and nameplates
Reusable service sets stored in the browser session
Responsive, high-density Canvas preview
Multi-page PDF download and browser print flow
Light, dark, and system themes
Still a lot to improve, if you’re in the printing business, I’d really love to hear your feedback.

name: Learning Hall PH
tagline: Turn DepEd lessons into quests kids actually want to play

— DepEd-Aligned Gamified Learning for Grades 2-6
Learning Hall turns daily homework into an epic quest.

Every quest is a real lesson — mapped directly to the DepEd curriculum and your child's actual classroom schedule. No fluff. No filler. Nothing advances for free. Every quest cleared, skill unlocked, curio caught, and battle won requires mastering the matching lesson first.
FOR GRADES 2-6 | ENGLISH & FILIPINO | Active on Web (Pending development: Offline First Android App)

The Daily Campaign:
A predictable 30-minute loop, Monday to Friday. Your child's subjects become campaign missions. Complete Filipino to unlock the Lorekeeper's vault. Conquer Math to tame the Number Realm.
Five Learning Guilds:
Focused skill-builders, not drills — Reading Comprehension (Lorekeeper), Typing Speed (SpellCaster), Mental Math (Number Realm), Critical Thinking (Logic Labyrinth), and Spelling & Vocabulary (Lexicon Arena).
Curio Arena — Battle, Collect, Learn:
Every correct answer weakens wild Curios. Defeat them to capture and train them. Each Curio is a collectible creature born from lesson mastery — the harder they study, the stronger it gets.
Live PvP:
Kids can send real-time battle invites to siblings and classmates. Same platform, real head-to-head battles, bragging rights included.
Special Events & Boss Fights:
Because Learning Hall tracks the classroom schedule, it gets ahead of it. Before summative tests, limited-time Events launch covering exactly what's being tested, with exclusive Curios as rewards. Term exams become full Boss Fights.
Built for Parents:
Screentime Solved: No doom-scrolling. A structured loop with clear start and end.
Parent-Controlled Rewards Vault:
Kids earn gold from mastery (no pay-to-win). Parents stock the vault with real-world treats, gaming time, and in-game rewards. Kids redeem, parents approve.
Calm Progress Dashboard:
See learning streaks and recent activity from your free parent account — a gentle check-in, not a nagging report.
Child-Safe by Design:
No ads, no pay-to-win, no random rewards.
Free forever for your first child. Add siblings, unlock journal viewing, and enable gold rewards with Premium at ₱249/year under one family login. (Early Access Users will be given lifetime premuim acces)
Learning Hall is made by parents, for parents — for elementary learners who deserve more than boring drills.
TLDR: DepEd-aligned, gamified learning for Grades 2-6. Every worksheet becomes a battle, every lesson a quest. Bilingual, parent-controlled, and free for your first child.

name: MyCart

name: Narra Warranty
tagline: The warranty your customer can't lose, issued at the counter in seconds.
features_and_description:
The problem
Philippine shops still hand out warranties on thermal paper. The ink fades within months, the slip gets lost, and a year later nobody can agree what was promised, so the shop either honours a claim it shouldn't or refuses one it should.
What Narra Warranty does
Your counter issues a digital warranty in about thirty seconds. The customer gets a link that opens on any phone, with no app to install, plus a printable PDF. Each warranty is cryptographically signed when issued and linked to the one before it, so any later edit breaks the seal. Batches are also timestamped against an independent authority, which proves a warranty existed on the day it says it did.
What's different
Anyone can verify a warranty without an account, including the customer and anyone settling a dispute. Terms are fixed to the warranty at issue, so editing a template later never rewrites what a customer was already promised. Claims are logged across branches, which is what stops the same entitlement being honoured twice.
Built for how shops here actually work. Customers without email get the link over Messenger, Viber or SMS. The warranty editor flags what RA 7394 requires a written warranty to state. Every warranty says plainly that it is not a BIR receipt.

name: Reality Check
tagline: Turn a gambling loss back into hours of your life.
features_and_description:
The problem
Betting apps and casinos sell a digital illusion. Chips, spins, "you almost won." Money stops feeling like money — it becomes a number on a screen you can lose without flinching.
What it does
Reality Check converts a loss back into things you actually feel. Enter what you lost, and it shows you that same amount as hours of your life at your real hourly wage, as weeks of groceries, as rent, as medicine.
It also includes:
A loss journal that makes you re-read your last entry before you're allowed to write a new one
A breakdown of the near-miss and random-payout psychology these apps are built on
A barriers checklist — self-exclusion, deleting apps, cutting saved payment methods, telling someone
Real helplines and self-exclusion programs for your country
A daily check-in that counts clean days
What makes it different
No account required. Your data stays in your browser. Sign-in is optional and only exists if you want the same journal on a second device. Asking someone to register an account before they'll admit they have a gambling problem is how you lose them.
Not country-locked. Pick your country and the help section switches to the real helplines, self-exclusion programs, and meetings for where you are — Philippines, US, UK, Australia, Singapore, or a general international set.
Installs from the browser. It's a PWA, so it goes on your home screen and works offline. No store listing, no install friction.
Free, with nothing paywalled — including cross-device sync.
Source is public under a noncommercial license, so anyone can fork it, point it at their own country's helplines, and run a free instance.
Available in English, Filipino, Cebuano, Hiligaynon, and Ilocano.

name: Devbrary

features_and_description:
Devbrary is a free reading library for developers. Instead of videos, courses, or a tangled roadmap graph, it's organized simply as Role → Category → Topic, where every topic is a focused, self-contained page you can actually read in 5–8 minutes.

Foundations — Git, the command line, how the web works, HTTP, debugging, data structures.
Frontend — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React/Vue/Angular/Svelte, Tailwind, Sass, and more.
Backend — Node.js, Python, Go, Java, C#, PHP, plus databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis) and GraphQL.
DevOps — Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Terraform, cloud, and observability.
What makes it different:
🆓 Free forever — no accounts, no paywalls, no ads. (By design, not a trial.)
📴 Offline-first PWA — install it, read it on the train, works with no connection.
🔒 Private — your reading progress is saved on your device, never a server.
🔗 Smartly connected — "Recommended first" prerequisites and "Explore more" links guide you between related topics, so you always know what to read next.
📓 Calm, field-notebook design — warm, distraction-free, with a proper dark mode.
Who it's for: developers who'd rather read than watch — self-taught devs, bootcamp grads and CS students, and working engineers filling gaps or picking up a new stack. Anyone who wants a well-organized, no-strings reference they can open and learn from immediately.

tagline: A sleek, privacy-focused alternative dashboard for Solarman API users.
features_and_description:
Sol · Solar Monitoring Dashboard
A self-hosted, privacy-first solar energy dashboard for Solarman-compatible inverters (Deye, Sofar, Solis, Luxpower, and others). Built as a clean, high-contrast alternative to the official app — optimized for wall-mounted tablets and 24/7 monitoring.
Features
Live Power Topology:
Animated SVG flow diagram showing solar generation, home consumption, battery charge/discharge, and grid import/export in real time. Comets trace active power paths for instant visual feedback.
Minute Telemetry Charts:
Full-resolution ECharts with solar, load, export, import, and net grid curves. Toggle series on/off, box-zoom, export as PNG. Per-day summary pills, hourly profiles, and daily breakdown tables.
Meralco Billing Cycle Savings:
Aligned to your actual Meralco cycle start day — not the calendar month. Live savings split into avoided cost (self-consumed solar × retail rate) and export credit (net-metered surplus × 50% retail). Weather-aware forecasts with confidence bands, cycle-over-cycle comparison, and lifetime ROI tracking.
Exact Bill Computation:
Enter meter readings once per cycle and the rate components from your Meralco statement (generation, transmission, system loss, distribution, VAT, universal charges). Auto-fills the next cycle, projects the current one, and tracks every bill with a YTD running total.
Device-Level Telemetry:
Per-inverter data straight from the Solarman API — DC string voltages and currents, AC output, grid frequency, inverter temperature, and operating status. Multi-inverter stations get a selector.
System Health & Alerts:
Five server-side alert rules run around the clock: system offline, zero production during daylight, below-usual output, inverter overtemperature or fault, and multi-week degradation. Alerts appear, update, and auto-resolve — with web push notifications for when the app is closed.
A/B Date Comparison:
Compare any two date ranges side-by-side (up to 31 days each) with paired daily bar charts and delta indicators for generation, load, surplus, and draw.
Battery SOC Tracking:
Coulomb-counting SOC estimation with calibration at full charge. Today's charge, solar charge, discharge, net energy, and time-to-full/time-to-empty estimates.
5-Day Weather Forecast:
Solarman weather API with automatic Open-Meteo satellite fallback. Icons, temperatures, and conditions for the week ahead.
12-Cycle History:
Scroll through 12 billing cycles of savings and generation. System health score normalized against your own 90-day baseline — a rainy month never looks like a failing array.
PWA & Mobile:
Install as a standalone app. Pull-to-refresh on mobile. Responsive from phones to 1080p wall tablets to 1920px+ desktop. Keyboard shortcuts (1–7 for navigation, R for refresh, S for settings).
Privacy-First Architecture:
No database, no account registration, no credentials stored. Your Solarman email and password are used only to obtain an API token — proxied through a stateless Express backend. The token is cached in-memory and persisted to a gitignored JSON file on your own server. Nothing leaves your machine.
Multi-Station Support:
Manage multiple Solarman stations with custom aliases. Per-station settings for retail rate, export rate, billing cycle start, installed capacity, system cost, and install date.

features_and_description:

Relmio is an open-source browser wizard that connects to your ChatGPT account through OAuth, safely checks your VPS and n8n setup, then installs a private bridge. It does not edit or restart your existing n8n container, and it does not expose the bridge publicly.
Once connected, n8n nodes such as OpenAI Chat Model, AI Agent, Basic LLM Chain, and HTTP Request can use account-supported Codex models, including gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, and gpt-5.6-luna.
Relmio can also work with free ChatGPT accounts. For free accounts, the highest available tier is gpt-5.6-terra, but the usage quota is very limited. Available models and limits depend on your account and may change.
Relmio and the upstream openai-oauth project are unofficial community projects. They do not create an OpenAI Platform API key and are intended for personal and experimental workflows.

features_and_description:

Selling

Getting paid

- Deposits and partial payments, with the balance carried to the customer's account
- Every method works offline — nothing waits on a network
- Payment instructions and a QR image on receipts, so customers can pay directly
Utang (customer credit)
- An append-only ledger per person: charges, payments, running balance
- Debt aged — who owes what, and how many days late
- A "who to chase first" list ordered by how overdue the money is
- Reminders you can send over Messenger or SMS
- Credit always attaches to a named person, never a walk-in
People
One list for customers, clients, suppliers and buyers, with balances, history, phone contacts import, and role filters.
Catalog and pricing
Products and services in one catalog: cost, price, margin, SKU/barcode, photo, category, unit of measure (kg, sack, bottle…), and expiry dates for stock that goes off. Price and cost changes are logged, so past profit doesn't move when you reprice.
Stock
- Reserved on add-to-cart, deducted on payment, returned on cancel — two customers can't buy the last one
- Every change is an audited movement, never an overwrite
- Low-stock and expiring-soon warnings
- Suppliers and purchase orders, including partial deliveries and scan-to-receive
- Printable barcode labels
- Deleting a received order takes the stock back off the shelf
Deliveries
A queue between "sold" and "in the customer's hands": each row carries the receipt to pack against, a money flag (paid / COD / balance due / on credit) so nobody collects twice or not at all, a map pin that works offline, and hand-off to the driver's own map app.
Cash handling
- Cashier shifts: time in with a counted float, live expected-cash, denomination counter at close, over/short flagged
- Per-cashier attribution on every sale
- E-wallet balances tracked separately from the drawer
- Padala — cash-in/cash-out with fee tiers
- Expenses, and recurring invoices/service plans
Documents
Branded receipts, quotations, invoices and statements of account — as PDF or image, shared over Messenger, SMS or email. All generated on the phone, offline.
Knowing where you stand
Daily/weekly/monthly/custom-range totals; real profit with costs and expenses taken out, not just sales; profit per item and per job; where your money is (drawer, e-wallets, owed to you); trends; top items; CSV export for your books.
Your data
- Offline-first — every feature above works with no signal
- Stored on the device; nothing is sent anywhere by default
- Encrypted backup file (AES-GCM, passphrase) you can save to Drive or Messenger
- Optional cloud backup, encrypted before it leaves the phone — the server holds ciphertext it cannot read
- CSV import, full change history, and one-tap erase
Setup
Several businesses in one app with fully separated data, English/Filipino switchable any time, a five-question setup, a getting-started checklist, in-app how-to guides, and sample data for trying things without touching real records.

name: SuriinPH
tagline: SA DISIMPORMASYON, DI KA PASISIIL.
features_and_description:
The Gap:
Facebook is the dominant gateway to news in the Philippines — 91% of Filipino internet users name it among their online news sources, more than any other platform (Pulse Asia, July 2026). Yet only about a third of Filipinos have developed a consistent habit of verifying what they see, most citing lack of time or not knowing how (Internews Philippines study, via PIDS). And among those who do verify through social media, more check what an influencer said (35%) than consult an actual fact-checker (26%) (Reuters Institute Digital News Report, 2025). The trusted, sourced fact-checking already exists — what's missing is easy access to it at the exact moment and place someone is asking the question.
Positioning:
SuriinPH does not compete with IFCN-certified fact-checkers such as VERA Files, Rappler, or AFP. It exists to extend their work — surfacing their published fact-checks, alongside government records and news reporting, directly into the comment thread where a claim is being discussed.
What It Is:
SuriinPH is an AI-assisted fact-checking assistant that Filipino Facebook users invoke by tagging @SuriinPH under a post or comment containing a claim they want checked. It replies publicly, in the same thread, with a sourced, claim-scoped explanation — visible to everyone who sees the original post.
How It Works:
A user tags @SuriinPH under a specific post or comment. The system checks recognized Philippine fact-checking sources, government records, and relevant news reporting for that specific claim, then generates a short, sourced explanation — never a conclusion without a citation — and posts it publicly in the same thread.
Current State:
SuriinPH is currently in closed testing, limited to an allowlist of test accounts, ahead of any broader public rollout.

Protect the app with a PIN, your fingerprint or face, or both. Choose to

MAKE IT YOURS
Seven themes, light and dark.

No ads. No analytics. No trackers. No third-party SDKs. No internet

The problem
Payslip deductions are a black box. You get a number with no reasoning, and no way to tell whether ₱1,620 for SSS is correct or ₱120 too much. Government offices are worse — people take a day off work, queue, and get sent home over a laminated birth certificate or a missing parental advice that nobody warned them about.
What Gabay does
Gabay means guide. Three jobs:
Checks your payslip. Enter what it says beside what the law gives, and get a line-by-line difference for SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, withholding tax and net pay — with the common innocent explanations for each gap, so you can ask HR a precise question instead of a suspicious one.
Tells you what to bring. Twelve government transactions — PSA, NBI, passport, PhilSys, licence, TIN, business permit and more — each with a checklist that saves as you gather documents over days.
Tells you what you're owed. Six statutory leaves, senior and PWD discount rules including the VAT treatment retail gets wrong, contract red flags, PhilHealth benefits, and an OFW recruiter check.
What's unique
Free calculators are everywhere. None of them show their work.
Every result renders as an itemised ledger with the rule cited beside each line — so an HR officer can defend the number, and an employee can challenge a wrong deduction and point at the schedule it came from. No bare numbers anywhere in the app.
And every government transaction carries a "why people get turned away" section: the field nobody publishes and everybody needs.
Everything compiles into the app — no backend, no account, no analytics, no network calls at all. It works on one bar of signal in a government queue, which is exactly when you need it.

tagline: Free, open-source 3D structural model viewer — built for engineers, by engineers
features_and_description:
I made an open-source structural viewer that lets you view 3D structural models without installing anything.
OpenBuilding
is a free, fully responsive browser-based viewer. Drop in a STAAD file (.std extension) and it renders members with their actual cross-section shapes — wide flanges, channels, angles, HSS, pipes — not generic cylinders. Click any member to see its section properties. The goal is to make structural visualization portable and accessible to everyone, including non-engineers who just need to see a model without buying software.
Currently supports
: STAAD (.std). ETABS, SAP2000, and ROBOT are on the roadmap. Material composition and member-end release data are in the works.
Limitations
: single-section members only (no double angles, double channels, or built-up sections). Plate rendering is basic. Some non-US steel naming conventions aren't mapped yet. No load or deformed-shape display.
This isn't structural analysis software, the aim is engineering reporting and construction visualization. Long-term, I'm open to adding basic analysis, but the focus right now is making model viewing frictionless.
It's fully open-source (MIT). If you're a structural engineer who codes or a developer into AEC tools, take a look. Every contribution helps move engineering tooling forward one step at a time.
You can download an example model in the GitHub link below that you can use to try the app.
Try it
: https://openbuilding.vercel.app/
Source

By tokenizing the cash grants into programmable digital assets, the system restricts spending to authorized merchants (e.g., groceries, pharmacies, and schools), completely eliminating the misuse of funds for gambling, alcohol, or non-essentials.

Biometric Smart Accounts:
Beneficiaries don't need to learn about crypto or manage seed phrases. They can access their wallets and sign transactions securely using their smartphone's FaceID or Fingerprint (WebAuthn/Passkeys).
Programmable Money & Merchant Whitelisting:
Smart contracts enforce strict rules so beneficiaries can only spend their grants at DSWD-approved partner merchants.
Offline-Ready QR Payments:
Beneficiaries can generate a signed transaction via QR code even without an active internet connection, which the merchant can then scan and relay to the blockchain.
Real-Time DSWD Dashboard:
Provides government agencies with a transparent, on-chain audit trail of all disbursements, dramatically reducing corruption and ghost beneficiaries.
Dual Ecosystem:
Comes with a Web App for DSWD admins and Merchants (built with Next.js) and a Mobile App for the beneficiaries (built with React Native/Expo).
4Ps-Nexus
bridges the gap between Web3 technology and real-world social impact, ensuring that every peso goes to the families who need it most.

name: Gigil
tagline: Don't hold it in. Let the feeling out before it takes over.
features_and_description:
Someone has been living rent-free in your head all week. You are never going to lay a finger on them, and you shouldn't. So build them here, take it out on a pile of polygons, and go back to your evening a lighter person.
The word
gigil
/ˈɡi.ɡil/ · Tagalog · noun
The full-body tremble that arrives when a feeling gets bigger than the person holding it. Jaw locked, hands closing on nothing. Filipinos use it for the urge to squeeze a baby's cheeks — and for the other thing, the one with no cheeks to squeeze.
Anger isn't the problem. Having nowhere to put it is.
Before you start
Stylised cartoon violence. Squashing, bruising and a lot of yelping. The damage is deliberately non-photoreal — it looks like a dented toy, never like an injury — and one button wipes all of it.
Not for young audiences. This isn't a children's game, and it isn't meant to be watched by one over your shoulder.
Don't upload people without their consent. Photos never leave your device, which is exactly why the judgement is yours alone. Someone who hasn't agreed to be here doesn't belong here.
It's a toy, not treatment. If the anger frightens you, or it's about someone you think you might actually hurt, close the tab and talk to a real person instead.

Summary

• Charts and stats over a chosen time period
• Team insights: who's carrying the load, who's blocked, and how work is trending
Search
Board search

Universal search

Filters

Time tracking

• Focused for small teams — enough structure to run real projects, without enterprise clutter
Who it's for
• Solo builders and pairs who want a clear board and honest time data
• Small agencies managing multiple client spaces
• Product teams tired of switching between a kanban tool and a time tracker
• Leads who want signal (blocked work, estimates, hours, completions) without a heavy PM suite

name: RIDERaiah
tagline: Connect intercom without internet

What the RIDERaiah App Does
The mobile app transforms Android-powered helmet systems or mobile devices into standalone, off-grid communication radios:
Offline Voice Channels (P2P Intercom):
It establishes secure, local wireless communication links (via UDP protocol) directly between rider devices. It broadcasts voice streams directly to nearby peers with zero internet, cellular data, or cloud servers required.
Dynamic QR Code Authentication:
Helmet interfaces are notoriously difficult to type on. The app solves this by allowing riders to register on this web portal, generate an encrypted off-grid Digital ID QR Code, and scan it with their helmet camera or device to log in instantly.
Call-Sign Broadcasts:
Instead of usernames or emails, riders are identified off-grid via their custom Call-Sign (Rider Codename) broadcasted directly to nearby peers on the channel.
Who It Is For
RIDERaiah
is engineered specifically for groups who need reliable, real-time voice communication on the road, including:

name: GUARDAN
tagline: Parental Monitoring app - monitor you child's device and protect them.
features_and_description:
Introducing GuarDan — a child monitoring and parental control application designed to help parents protect and guide their children in today's digital world.
As children spend more time online, parents face increasing challenges in keeping them safe from harmful content, excessive screen time, and online risks. GuarDan was built to provide parents with better visibility into their child's device activity while encouraging responsible digital habits.
👨‍👩‍👧 Why I Built GuarDan
Recent incidents involving young people have reminded many families of the importance of staying involved in their children's digital lives. As children spend more time using smartphones and other gadgets, parents face increasing challenges in protecting them from online risks, harmful content, cyberbullying, scams, and excessive screen time.
Protecting Our Children from Online Nihilism and Extremist Radicalization
The tragic school shooting in Leyte last week is a painful reminder that the threat to our children is no longer confined to the streets. It has moved online, embedded in gaming platforms, encrypted chats, and social media feeds, where extremist groups like the 764 Network quietly groom, manipulate, and radicalize our youth.
- Philippine Institute of Cyber Security
I built GuarDan to support parents and legal guardians by providing tools that help them supervise and guide their children's device usage responsibly. The goal is not to invade a child's privacy, but to help parents encourage safer digital habits, maintain open communication, and provide an additional layer of protection while their children navigate the online world.
🔐 Key Features
📸 Camera Access - Access the device's front or rear camera remotely when needed.
📱 Live Screen - View the child's device screen in real time to understand what they're currently doing.
🛡️ App Manager - Allow or block specific applications to help prevent access to inappropriate or distracting apps.
💬 SMS Logs - View incoming and outgoing text messages for monitoring purposes.
📞 Call Logs - Review call history, including incoming, outgoing, and missed calls.
📍 Live Location - Track the device's real-time GPS location and monitor movement history.
🌐 Browser History - View websites visited to help ensure safe internet browsing.
🔍 Keyword Monitor - Receive alerts when potentially harmful, abusive, or concerning keywords are detected.
⚡ Live Activity Feed - Monitor device activity such as app launches, screen interactions, and user actions.
🔒 System Lock - Remotely lock the device when immediate attention or restricted access is needed.
🔊 Wake-Up Alarm - Trigger a loud alarm to quickly get the child's attention or help locate the device nearby.
⏳ Screen Time - Set daily usage limits to encourage healthy digital habits and reduce excessive screen time.
🚨 Emergency SOS - Allows the child to send an emergency alert to the parent with a single tap.
🎙️ Surround Sound - Listen to ambient sounds around the device when necessary for safety situations.
👻 Stealth Mode - Hide or show the application's icon on the monitored device for a cleaner interface.
⚖️ Legal & Responsible Use
GuarDan is intended solely for legitimate parental control and child safety purposes. It is designed to be used only by parents or legal guardians on devices they own, provide, manage, or are otherwise authorized to monitor. Users are responsible for ensuring that the application is used in accordance with all applicable laws, regulations, and privacy requirements in their jurisdiction.
Important Limitations
❌ Do not use GuarDan to spy on adults or other individuals without their authorization.
❌ Do not use GuarDan to record or intercept conversations in ways that violate privacy rights or applicable laws.
❌ Do not use GuarDan to access accounts or devices that you do not own or are not legally authorized to manage.
✅ Use GuarDan responsibly to help protect and guide your own minor children while respecting privacy, trust, and the law.

name: Anti Kamote Game
tagline: Learn the rules. Stop being kamote. #AntiKamoteGame
features_and_description:
Anti Kamote Game — learn Philippine traffic rules by actually driving them.
It's a browser-based ride-hailing game set across three real Philippine maps — Metro Manila, Metro Cebu, and Davao — with 94 actual pickup and drop-off points between them. Pick up passengers, follow real city routes, and answer real LTO-style driving-rule questions at every turn, junction, and hazard along the way. Get them right and you keep your passenger happy, your rating high, and your fares rolling in — get them wrong and you'll drive like the kamote you're trying not to be.
Every trip teaches you something: right of way, road signs, speed limits, expressway etiquette — 262 questions across 15 categories, each one cited to an official source like RA 4136 or the LTO manual. Flub one and it follows you: missed questions land in My Kamote Moments and keep coming back until your right answers have caught up with your wrong ones. When you want to know where you actually stand, the LTO Mock Exam is 60 questions, 25 minutes, 75% to pass, scored by category.
Earn XP to climb from a beat-up starter ride to F1 machines, unlock 35 vehicles and 19 companies, chase achievements, and race up global weekly leaderboards. Sign in with Google and start driving.
How to Play
1. Pick your city
Manila, Cebu, or Davao — all three open from your first shift, nothing to unlock. Your money, level, garage and collection come with you, so switch whenever you like.
2. Go online
Flip the dispatch switch in your dashboard to start receiving booking offers.
3. Accept a booking
Drive to the pickup point, then bring your passenger to their drop-off. Your car follows the route on its own. Watch for surge jobs — they pay extra against a deadline, but speeding to beat it earns real tickets, and the fines come straight off your receipt.
4. Answer road questions
Real Philippine traffic-rule questions pop up along the way. Correct answers keep your passenger happy and your driving smooth — wrong ones cost mood, health, and stars, and the road follows up with something harder in the same category.
5. Earn and maintain
Fares and tips go to your wallet. Spend some on fuel and repairs — you can't accept bookings when the tank or your vehicle is too low.
6. Level up
Gain XP, keep your star rating high, unlock better vehicles and companies, collect 36 passengers in the Codex, and rescue the occasional stray.
It rains when it's actually raining in Manila, it gets dark when it's dark, and the roads get slower and slipperier for it — so switch your headlights on and ease off.
Disclaimer: this is a beta and a vibe coded side project, so expect rough edges. Inspired by Barg (also posted here) and mainly by the everyday chaos of driving in Metro Manila.

name: Smiloo: App Blocker and Focus
tagline: App Blocker, Smile, Focus, Screentime
features_and_description:
Take back control of your screen time with Smiloo, the app blocker that makes focus fun and engaging.
HOW SMILOO WORKS
Choose the apps that distract you most. When you try to open them, Smiloo asks you to complete a short focus action before unlocking. You pick how you want to unlock: Studying, Breathing, Prayer, Intention, Pause, or Expression. That brief moment creates mindfulness and helps you decide if you really need that app. It sounds simple because it is, and it works.
Smiloo uses Android’s AccessibilityService API to detect when you launch blocked apps and display the focus action overlay. This permission is required solely for the core app-blocking functionality — to identify app launches and show the custom interface. No data is collected, shared, or transmitted via this service; all processing remains local on your device. You can disable it anytime in Android Settings > Accessibility.
A DIFFERENT KIND OF APP BLOCKER
Traditional blockers just lock you out completely. Smiloo takes a smarter approach. Instead of harsh restrictions that you eventually disable, it adds a meaningful step that interrupts automatic scrolling. Users report saving hours each day by becoming more intentional about their phone use.
FEATURES
Six focus types to unlock. Choose how you want to pause before opening blocked apps. Studying for a quick study checkpoint. Breathing for a calming breath. Prayer for a moment of reflection. Intention to set your purpose. Pause for a beat before you decide. Expression with over 15 facial expressions like smile, wink, or surprised face. Each type becomes a small moment of mindfulness.
Real time detection for expression mode. When you use expressions, advanced facial recognition works accurately in various lighting and responds instantly. Your privacy matters. All expression detection happens on your device. Your facial data is never stored or transmitted. We cannot see your face, and we designed it that way.
Track your progress. View detailed statistics showing your focus streaks, blocked attempts, and weekly progress reports on your digital wellbeing journey.
Flexible difficulty modes. Choose between Gentle, Strict, and ADHD modes to match your needs. Each mode adjusts challenge levels and how long apps stay unblocked.
PREMIUM INCLUDES
Block unlimited apps instead of just one. Access all six focus types including all expressions. Get priority support when you need help.
BUILT FOR
Students preparing for exams. Professionals seeking productivity. Anyone reducing social media time. Parents modeling healthy habits. People with ADHD managing impulses.
THE APPROACH
Adding small friction before habitual behaviors helps break automatic patterns. The moment it takes to study, breathe, pray, set an intention, pause, or make an expression engages your conscious mind, giving you the chance to make a real choice about how you spend your time.
Download Smiloo and start your journey toward more mindful phone use today.

Vidaria is a focused botanical community where plant collectors, enthusiasts, and experts can document specimens, exchange knowledge, and build more trustworthy plant records together.
Instead of treating plants as ordinary social-media content, Vidaria gives every observation, contribution, identification, and collection its proper context. Share your plants, preserve their history, explore structured botanical information, and connect with people who value accurate and responsible plant knowledge.
Document Your Living Collection
Create posts about your plants, growing experiences, discoveries, and greenhouse notes. Add photos, associate a species, choose who can view your content, and participate in conversations with other collectors.
Your Vidarium profile brings your botanical identity into one place, including your posts, plants, reshared content, contributions, and community trust.
Explore Trusted Botanical Knowledge
Browse the Vidaria Plant Database to discover structured botanical records using scientific or common names, geographic filters, and taxonomic categories.
Records are designed to preserve more than a plant name. Vidaria supports sourced information, specimen imagery, contributor attribution, revision history, and community stewardship so knowledge can remain useful over time.
Members may also propose new species, cultivar, or hybrid records and suggest updates to existing entries.
Verification Strengthened by Experts
Vidaria’s Check & Balance system supports structured plant identification and record review.
Submit a plant specimen with images and relevant information for expert evaluation. Reviewers may approve the record, suggest a correction, request clearer photographs, or provide additional guidance.
Technology may assist the process, but trusted human reviewers remain the final authority. The goal is not instant certainty—it is a stronger, more transparent record.
Join Focused Collectives
Collectives bring together specialist groups built around particular plant families, genera, regions, cultivation interests, and botanical communities.
Explore verified plant records alongside the groups that help keep their knowledge active. Connect with collectors who share your interests and participate in communities centered on useful, focused discussion rather than unnecessary social-media noise.
Discover Events and Organize Plant Care
Find community plant events, exhibitions, shows, workshops, and gatherings through Vidaria’s integrated calendar.
Save events and review your upcoming agenda in one place. You can also create private plant-care reminders for watering, fertilizing, repotting, treatment, inspection, and other recurring tasks.
Plant-care reminders remain private to your account and can be scheduled once, daily, weekly, monthly, or at a custom interval.
Build Your Botanical Identity
Your public Vidarium profile can include:
• A unique Vidaria ID
• Profile photo and biography
• Posts, plants, and reshared galleries
• Follower and following connections
• Community roles and contribution history
• Trust and verification indicators
• Optional links to your external pages
Privacy controls allow you to manage whether content is visible publicly, only to accepted friends, or only to you.
A Community Designed Around Trust
Vidaria is built around visible attribution, expert review, responsible moderation, structured records, and privacy-aware relationships.
Posts and plant records are not treated as disposable content. Contributions can be reviewed, corrected, improved, and preserved so future collectors can understand where information came from and how it developed.
Whether you are documenting your first plant, maintaining a rare collection, supporting botanical education, or contributing specialist knowledge, Vidaria gives your plants a place where their identity and history can continue growing.
Document. Verify. Share.
Vidaria — A living record, built together.

name: EZ2 Lotto
tagline: Instant draw results, stats, and ticket checks, all in one sleek app.
features_and_description:
APK FILE
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1P_P6FxcJqWAEeFXnSsj3fW6mB7QLP7KF/view?usp=sharing
**EZ2 Lotto** is a Flutter-based mobile application for tracking **Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) EZ2 / 2D Lotto** results in real time. It delivers live draw updates, a full historical archive, statistical analysis, and ticket verification — all powered by a Supabase backend with realtime subscriptions and automated web scraping.
**Version:** `1.0.2` · **Platform:** Android / iOS / Web · **Language:** Dart 3 (Flutter)
---
## 🚀 Features
### Live Draw Results
- Real-time updates for all three daily draws (2 PM / 5 PM / 9 PM PHT) via Supabase Realtime channels.
- Draw status indicators — **LIVE**, **SOON**, or **CLOSED** — calculated against the Philippine Time draw windows.
- Auto-refresh cadence increases during active draw windows and backs off outside them.
### Historical Archive
- Browse past results grouped by **year → month → day**, with per-draw winner counts.
- Cache-first data strategy: past months are treated as immutable and never re-fetched; the current month refreshes after 30 minutes; today refreshes after 10 minutes during draw windows or 60 minutes otherwise.
### Statistics & Insights
- **Hot numbers** — most frequently drawn digits across a configurable lookback range.
- **Cold numbers** — least frequently drawn digits with days-since-last-seen counters.
- **Top combos** — most repeated two-digit pairs, sorted by frequency.
- **Pair analysis** — per-digit frequency split by first vs. second position.
- **Winner charts** — draw-level winner counts to spot high-payout trends.
### Ticket Checker
- **Camera / Gallery OCR** — upload a ticket photo; the `read-ticket` Supabase Edge Function extracts the printed numbers.
- **Manual input** — enter combos directly with date and draw-slot filters.
- **Prize calculation** — determines Straight vs. Rambolito match type and computes the payout.
### Offline Support
- `CacheService` persists all fetched results and metadata in `SharedPreferences`.
- The app launches instantly from cache and synchronizes in the background when connectivity is restored.
- An **offline banner** is displayed when `ConnectivityService` detects no active network.
### Settings & Preferences
- **Dark mode** — full Material 3 light/dark theming (seed color `#C0392B`).
- **Language toggle** — English / Filipino, persisted across sessions via `AppLocale`.
- **In-app update checker** — queries the `app_versions` Supabase table and prompts users to download the latest APK.
- **Admin tools** — debug screen for inspecting cache state and triggering manual fetches.
### Security
- **Root / jailbreak detection** — blocks launch on compromised devices or when Developer Options are enabled (release mode only) via `flutter_jailbreak_detection`.
- **Credential injection** — Supabase URL and anon key are provided exclusively through `--dart-define` at build time; never hardcoded in production artifacts.
---
## 🧭 App Screens
| Tab | Screen | Description |
| --- | ------ | ----------- |
| **Results** | `TodayScreen` | Today's live results with draw status indicators (LIVE / SOON / CLOSED). |
| **History** | `HistoryScreen` | Year/month navigator with per-day result cards and winner counts. |
| **Statistics** | `StatsScreen` | Hot/cold numbers, top combos, pair analysis, and winner trend charts. |
| **Ticket** | `TicketScreen` | OCR scan or manual entry to check tickets and compute prizes. |
| **Settings** | `SettingsScreen` | Dark mode, language, update checker, share, and admin/debug tools. |

(~5 minutes)
MacroChef works best with two keys, both free — no credit card required. Keys are entered in-app and stored on your device only (the LLM key in the OS keychain via secure storage).
1. Groq — free AI provider (recipes, macro estimates, voice intents)
Groq's free tier is the fastest way to get the AI features running:
Sign up at
https://console.groq.com
(free account).
Go to API Keys → Create API Key and copy the key (shown once).
In MacroChef: Settings → AI Provider → set the provider dropdown to Groq → paste the key under API Key → Save key.
Tap Test connection to confirm it works.
Prefer another provider? Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini work the same way (paid keys), or pick Local to download an on-device model and skip API keys entirely — see Choosing an AI provider.
2. USDA FoodData Central — free food database (accurate macros)
The USDA database is the app's first and most accurate source for food macros:
Request a key at
https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/api-key-signup
— instant, free, arrives by email.
In MacroChef: Settings → Food Data → paste it under USDA API Key → Save USDA key.
Without a USDA key the app still works — lookups fall back to OpenFoodFacts and AI estimates — but generic whole foods (chicken breast, rice, oats…) resolve far more accurately with it.

name: Tantya
tagline: Material estimates & quotations for Philippine contractors
features_and_description:
This idea started while I was renovating the house I was renting, with the landlord's approval. I watched the contractor prepare quotations almost entirely by estimation. Instead of calculating based on actual quantities, they would often look at the job and say things like, *"This should be enough."* There wasn't much data or calculation behind the estimate.
Human memory isn't perfect, and whether it's a small renovation or a large construction project, I realized how important accurate and consistent estimating is.
There are already some estimating tools available, but none of them offered the level of functionality I was looking for, so I decided to build one myself.
It's called "Tantya"(Temporary), a free (for now) estimating tool for small construction and renovation projects.
The tool takes care of the calculations for you. Simply enter the project dimensions and choose the type of work—such as CHB walls, tiling, painting, and more. It will automatically calculate the estimated material quantities, including waste allowance and contingency.
Material prices are provided as editable reference values. Before generating the final quotation, users can replace them with prices from their own suppliers. Once everything is ready, the estimate can be converted into a professional PDF quotation or shared through a link that clients can open and approve directly from their phones.
From a technical perspective, the application is built with Next.js and PostgreSQL as an offline-first PWA, because reliable internet access isn't always available on construction sites. PDF quotations are available in both English and Tagalog, while the application itself supports English, Tagalog, Korean, and Chinese.
As for the pricing data, I researched publicly available prices from online construction suppliers in the Philippines and used them as reference values, keeping track of their sources. However, the final quotation is intentionally designed to be editable because material prices often vary by supplier, location, and local offline stores.
The built-in prices serve only as a starting point, allowing contractors and estimators to customize the quotation using their own actual supplier costs.
All of the data shown in the images is dummy data for demonstration purposes.

- Kahulugan (Definition): Ang ibig sabihin ng sagot. Madalas nakapwesto ito sa unahan o hulihan ng pangungusap.
- Sangkap (Fodder): Ang mga salita o letra na gagamitin mo para buuin ang sagot.
- Tanda (Indicator): Ang utos kung ano ang dapat gawin sa sangkap—tulad ng paghalo (anagram), pagbaligtad (reversal), o pagkuha sa unang letra, atbp.

* GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) - Check whether AI answers (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) actually cite your pages, track it query by query, and see who's being cited instead.
Built for SEO beginners who need plain-English guidance, in-house marketers who want their backlog automated, and agencies managing dozens of properties with client-ready wins reports.
Read-only and privacy-first: CiteWins requests only the read-only Search Console scope and never writes to your Google account.

Baery is the all-in-one app for solo and home-based bakeries that take custom cake and cookie orders. Manage every order, know your true margins, track your stock, and remember your customers — all from your phone, all offline, all yours.
Most bakery software is built for enterprise wholesale, hides behind a monthly subscription, or only does one thing. Baery does the four things a custom-order baker actually juggles every day, in one warm, beautifully simple app you buy once.

Stop losing orders across phone calls, Instagram DMs, and sticky notes.

Finally know what each bake really costs — and what to charge.

• Update an ingredient price once and every recipe updates automatically.
• Track price history so you can see when your costs creep up.
SMART INVENTORY + WASTE TRACKER
Stop the waste. Never run out mid-order.
• Do quick stock counts and log restocks and waste with a reason.
• Get low-stock and expiration alerts before they cost you a sale.
• See at a glance which recipes a low ingredient affects.
LIGHTWEIGHT CRM
Turn one-time buyers into regulars.
• Keep customer records with contact info, notes, and full order history.
• Get gentle birthday and reorder nudges so your best customers come back.
WHY BAKERS LOVE BAERY
• One-time purchase — no subscription, ever.
• Fully offline — your data lives on your device, not on someone's server.
• No accounts, no sign-up, no cloud lock-in.
• Manual backup and restore whenever you want, via your own Drive, iCloud, or email.
• A warm, craft-forward design made for a bakery, not a spreadsheet.
Baery is built for the baker who does it all. Download it once and get back to what you do best.

name: SplitPals
tagline: Split bills with your barkada. No install, no drama, no awkwardness.
features_and_description:
SplitPals started from something that happens all the time with my friends. Someone always pays first, planning to get paid back later, but after a few days, nobody remembers exactly how much was owed. Sometimes the receipt is gone. Sometimes you're not even sure if there's still a balance at all.
As a university student who often hangs out with my barkada, I ran into this over and over. So I built SplitPals, not just as a project, but as something I actually use with my own friends.
Add what everyone ordered, and SplitPals calculates each person's share instantly. No spreadsheet, no mental math. Share a clean, receipt-style summary straight to your barkada, so nobody has to ask "sino may utang sa akin?" anymore. It works right in your browser. No app store, no download, just a quick Google sign-in.
SplitPals took early design inspiration from Tarsi, an app that I really admire. From there, I built my own direction: a corgi as the face of the app. It's not just there to look cute. The corgi is meant to feel like that one friend in the barkada who actually keeps track of who owes what, so nobody else has to. Loyal, a little nosy in a good way, always on your side.
Built for barkadas who split everything, even the awkward part.

name: AlertSync: Citizen
tagline: A real-time hazard notification and emergency SOS alert mobile application.
features_and_description:
The Inspiration:
During major floods and disasters, emergency calls are often scattered across Facebook timelines and comment sections, causing critical requests to get lost in the noise. AlertSync was built to solve this by creating a centralized, real-time emergency ecosystem that bypasses social media clutter.
​Description:
AlertSync is a native Android application (built in Java) engineered to centralize disaster response and community awareness. Instead of relying on unorganized social media posts during floods or crises, the platform allows users to submit real-time, crowdsourced situation reports directly from the ground. This data instantly syncs via Google Firebase to a dedicated Responder Management System, ensuring that emergency personnel see precise locations and legitimate calls for help without lag.
​Key Technical Highlights:
​Centralized SOS Dispatch: Eliminates scattered social media callouts by routing emergency alerts straight to a dedicated responder dashboard.
​Crowdsourced Real-Time Mapping: Enables users to report localized situations (e.g., flood levels, blocked roads) so the community stays informed in real time.
​Low-Latency Architecture: Powered by Firebase Realtime Database and core API integrations to guarantee instant data sync when seconds count.

name: BarangayOS
tagline: Built by the people, for the people.
features_and_description:
So I spent the last few weeks doing something slightly unhinged: building a whole system for barangays instead of enjoying my last bit of summer before college.
Here's the thing that got me started. Most barangay runs a lot of its work on paper and memory. Someone needs a clearance, and someone else has to go dig through a logbook. A blotter case gets filed, and it lives in a folder that could get lost, soaked in a flood, or eaten by termites (this genuinely happens). Budget reports get pieced together by hand before every meeting.
Nobody's fault. Just how things have always been.
So, with way too much free time and a mild caffeine addiction, I built
BarangayOS
.
It keeps track of residents, documents, blotter cases, assets, and barangay finances in one place.
It still works even when the internet decides to take a break, which, let's be honest, happens a lot in a lot of barangays. Records also get backed up, so they don't just vanish because a laptop finally gave up on life.
In human terms: shorter waits for simple clearances. Officials who can actually see their budget instead of assembling it like a puzzle. Records that survive a hard drive dying. Less time on repetitive paperwork, more time actually helping people.
I'm giving this away for free. Fully open source.
Any barangay can use it. Any developer can improve it.
I'm not trying to sell anything, I just think digital governance shouldn't only exist in big cities with big budgets. It should be something small towns can have too. Might as well start here, in Bayawan.
I'm still just a student, technically not even in college yet. I don't have this all figured out, and I learned a good chunk of this while building it. But I wanted to actually contribute something real to my hometown.
If you're from a barangay, a fellow dev, or just someone who thinks local governance deserves better tools, feel free to check it out or even contribute.
Small step. Hopefully it becomes something bigger than just me overthinking things at 2am.
Quick disclaimer:
this is an open-source tool, not an official government platform, and it doesn't come with any warranty or guarantee. If your barangay wants to actually use it, please read the Privacy Notice, Terms of Use, and Data Processing Agreement in the repo first. Your barangay stays fully responsible for your own residents' data (you own it, you control it, I just built the tool), and it's a good idea to run it by your Sangguniang Barangay and maybe legal counsel before rolling it out officially.

What It Does
1. Zero-Friction Passive Capture
Context Reader: Uses native accessibility hooks to ingest structured on-screen text in real-time with automatic de-duplication.
Notification Listener: Logs incoming correspondence and alerts from permitted applications (such as WhatsApp, Messenger, and SMS), mapping them directly to your timeline.
Intelligent Snapshotting: A dedicated floating bubble lets you manually capture any screen. If no structural text is exposed, it instantly triggers offline OCR to extract text from the pixels.

3. Hybrid High-Performance Recall
Dual-Engine Search: Combines native SQLCipher FTS5 keyword search (with stemming and fuzzy matching) with an optional semantic search vector engine using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).
On-Device Semantic Search: Toggle to download a highly optimized, local 37 MB bge-small embedding model to vectorize your vault and query your history by abstract concept and intent rather than strict keywords.
Grounded RAG Chat: Access your data inside or outside the app via an overlay native floating chat. A local Large Language Model (LLM) uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to answer questions, constrained entirely by your captured history.
Privacy Posture
Zero-Trust by Design: Absolute data isolation. Every component (from raw screen ingestion and OCR text extraction to vector generation, LLM inference, and database storage) executes fully sandboxed on your physical hardware. Verification requires only the embedded public keys—no private key, account, or internet connection. Multi-signature documents are fully supported, allowing multiple people to independently sign the same file while preserving every signature.

Sign documents, PDFs, Office files, images, audio, video, source code, archives, and more—all while keeping the original file fully usable.

🔐 Hybrid Post-Quantum Security
Every signature combines Ed25519 with ML-DSA-87 (NIST FIPS-204), protecting files against both today's attacks and future quantum computers.

features_and_description:
[ Naru ]
— Codename
A counseling management SaaS for local school counseling offices in the Philippines.
[ One-line Definition ]
A native counseling-record CRM for school guidance counselors in the Philippines, combined with automated parent reporting and crisis-management safety workflows. The same codebase can also support CRM-style use cases for Korean education agencies, language schools, or study-abroad organizations that send students to the Philippines, but the product's primary identity is a school counseling office system.
[ Core Problem ]
Student counseling records in many local schools in the Philippines are often scattered across paper files, Excel sheets, and individual notes. For guidance counselors, one of the biggest bottlenecks is organizing report content for parents while still protecting the confidentiality of each student's counseling records. In addition, when a student at risk is identified — such as suicide risk, abuse, or bullying — there is often no suitable tool to systematically record the reporting and referral process.
[ Naru connects the entire flow into one system: ]
referral intake → counseling record → AI draft → counselor review → parent link delivery. Crisis situations are managed separately through dedicated flags and referral tracks.
[ Product DNA ]
— Records Built Around Who's Reading Them
Counseling records aren't kept as a single note. Each entry is separated by who's meant to read it — what the parent sees, what stays inside the school, and what stays private to the counselor alone. That separation is what makes it safe for a counselor to write an honest note without worrying it'll end up in front of a parent.
[ Core Features for School Counseling Offices ]
Student Records
: Manage grade level, section/class, areas of concern such as academic, personal/social, or career, assigned counselor, and guardian consent status.
Referral Intake
: A channel where homeroom teachers or other staff can refer students for counseling. The flow supports statuses such as received, under review, and closed.
Group Counseling & Programs
: Create counseling programs, manage sessions, and track attendance.
Crisis Management
: Flags for suicide risk, child abuse, and bullying, along with records for referral to the Child Protection Committee, or CPC. This is designed as a “flag + reporting procedure” workflow aligned with the intent of DepEd Child Protection Policy, DO 40, s.2012, and the Anti-Bullying Act, RA 10627. It does not include standardized psychological testing, since that area may fall under different professional boundaries between licensed guidance counselors and licensed psychologists. Naru maintains its position as a records and administrative workflow tool.
Parent Communication
: AI draft → counselor review → delivery. Parents can view reports through a link without creating an account.
Counselor Confidentiality
: Counselors can only view records of students assigned to them, reflecting the confidentiality practices of school counseling. However, crisis-management records are treated as an exception and can be viewed across the organization. When student safety is involved, appropriate information sharing takes priority over strict confidentiality.
[ Parallel Support ]
The same codebase also supports an agency-type organization model for study-abroad agencies. This includes lead-to-case conversion, language school matching, visa/document management, and parent reporting. The two organization types branch during onboarding, and the screens and terminology are adjusted accordingly.
[ Current Status ]
The core school-counseling feature set is complete — student records, referral intake, group counseling and programs, crisis management, and statistics — along with multilingual support for five languages, parent document uploads, PIN lock, and encrypted data export. The product is currently in free beta. Payments, native mobile apps, NEIS integration, and standardized psychological testing are explicitly out of scope.

name: RoutePOV
tagline: See every turn, climb, and descent before you go.
features_and_description:
RoutePOV — First-Person 3D Route Reconnaissance
RoutePOV is a privacy-focused web application that transforms standard GPX files into immersive, first-person 3D flythroughs over real terrain. Designed for overlanders, cyclists, trail runners, and adventure riders, the platform allows users to preview every turn, climb, and descent before ever setting foot—or wheel—on the track. By removing the friction of traditional mapping software, RoutePOV acts as a dedicated digital reconnaissance tool, giving users a precise visual understanding of what lies ahead.
Key Capabilities
First-Person 3D Rendering: Upload any standard GPX file and instantly simulate your trip from a driver, rider, or runner’s perspective. The camera moves fluidly along your exact path over highly accurate, global elevation data.
Variable Playback Speeds: Preview your route at any pace that suits your planning needs. Speed through long highway stretches at vehicle speeds, or slow down to walking pace to evaluate technical mountain singletracks and trail sections.
Zero-Storage Privacy Architecture: Built with data security at its core, GPX files are processed entirely in-memory server-side. Route coordinates are extracted to build the interactive 3D environment and discarded instantly. No files are written to disk, no databases are used, and no logs or routes are stored.
Seamless Global Performance: Utilizing open-source global elevation data, the app covers the entire planet—from local trails to remote mountain ranges like the Alps or Andes. Terrain tiles are preloaded along the route before playback begins to ensure smooth, uninterrupted camera movement without loading pauses.
Engineered For Every Discipline
Overlanders: Scout remote 4x4 tracks to evaluate road widths, spot clear terrain for campsites, and assess potential clearance challenges before committing a vehicle.
Cyclists: Read the exact gradient profiles, evaluate steep climbs, and visualize technical descents to optimize pacing and gear selection before hitting the tarmac or gravel.
Trail Runners: Complete virtual reconnaissance for ultramarathons and backcountry trail races, allowing athletes to study elevation gains, terrain changes, and aid station logistics.
Adventure Riders: Visualize unpaved mountain passes and winding switchbacks to gauge terrain difficulty, pinpoint optimal fuel stops, and find the best riding lines.
How It Works
Upload: Drop a standard .gpx file exported from any major ecosystem (including Garmin, Strava, Suunto, or Komoot). No account creation or sign-in is required.
Parse: The application securely parses the file server-side, extracting the necessary coordinates entirely in-memory.
Preview: The path is immediately rendered over cached 3D elevation tiles, allowing you to hit play and experience your route from start to finish.

name: Framing Plan
tagline: A focused browser workspace for early-stage floor framing.
features_and_description:
Framing Plan — Coordinated, Review-Ready Layouts
Framing Plan is a focused, browser-based workspace tailored for early-stage structural floor and roof framing design. Built to bridge the critical gap between conceptual design and professional engineering review, it allows structural designers, architects, and building contractors to rapidly sketch and iterate joist layouts, beams, and openings without the friction of heavy CAD software. By digitizing what is traditionally sketched on paper or whiteboards, the tool serves as a dedicated digital thinking space that speeds up early-stage drafting workflows while enforcing practical structural parameters.
The Design Sequence
The application functions via a fluid, three-step design pipeline on a lightweight browser canvas:
Shape the Footprint: Design teams can begin from a basic rectangle, preset layout, or pre-made template, adjusting wall lengths and dragging vertices directly on the canvas.
Resolve the Framing: The engine automatically populates the footprint with joists, grid lines, load-bearing walls, openings, and beams, offering real-time member readouts and structural span feedback.
Annotate & Export: Users can layer the layout with architectural symbols, precise dimensions, and alignment-guided markup before exporting clean, standardized preliminary sheets for engineering inspection.
Key Capabilities
Parametric Layout Engine: A metric-first, code-table-driven engine that instantly re-resolves the entire structural layout when changes are made. If a user modifies the span direction, spacing, grid paths, openings, or entire footprint dimensions, the system adapts instantly without requiring a manual redraw or project restart.
Engineering Visibility Tools: Provides immediate structural feedback directly in the workspace. Designers can monitor load-bearing walls, track member schedules, and view live joist and beam span warnings as they sketch to verify layouts fall within standard code-table thresholds.
Intuitive Canvas Controls: Built with precision-focused drafting tools including multi-select functionality, snap-to-wall mechanics, alignment guides, and direct edge-and-wall editing variables.
Project Continuity: Supports workflow flexibility by allowing users to save their progress locally or straight to a configured project backend, ensuring files can be reopened and iterated upon seamlessly.
Format Outputs
Framing Plan produces clean, layered outputs designed to fit into standard industry tech stacks:
PNG: A flat plan-view image ideal for design conversations, notes, and direct team messaging.
PDF: Presentation-ready preliminary drawing sheets appended with essential project and date metadata.
DXF (CAD): Layered files containing cleanly separated vector lines for walls, joists, beams, grids, and openings, allowing flawless handoffs directly into AutoCAD, Revit, and other major CAD platforms.

name: Seatmate

features_and_description:
Seatmate — An Offline Study Companion for Filipino Students
Seatmate is a mobile app designed to help students stay organized and motivated in their academic work, built specifically with the realities of Filipino students in mind: unreliable internet access, limited data budgets, and the isolation of studying without support.
The current version (MVP) focuses on three core functions: quiz tracking, subject organization, and grade logging. The application operates entirely offline. There is no account creation, no cloud dependency, and no data collection. All user information is stored locally on the device, which addresses both the connectivity constraints many students face and growing concerns around data privacy.
Product Vision
The long-term goal is to evolve Seatmate from a tracking tool into an adaptive study companion. Planned features include:
Interactive quizzing based on a student's own material
Personalized study planning that breaks down topics into manageable sessions
Behavioral nudges that respond to patterns of disengagement or procrastination
The underlying thesis is that academic underperformance is often less a function of ability and more a function of environment: students study alone, without structure or accountability. Seatmate is designed to address that gap directly, by pairing every student with a companion that provides structure, consistency, and motivation over time.
Current Status
Seatmate is an early-stage MVP, developed independently without external funding. It is currently available as a direct APK download for Android, ahead of a planned Play Store release.

The Problem
: Watching anime or reading manga online usually means navigating through heavily ad-riddled websites, dealing with broken streams, or jumping between multiple platforms just to track your favorite series. The current streaming landscape is often fragmented, slow, and frustrating for users who just want to watch their shows.
The Solution:
Yorumi provides a seamless desktop application that aggregates high-quality streams and manga chapters into one beautiful, native-feeling interface. Powered by a robust custom backend scraping API, it automatically resolves the best available video sources across multiple providers, handles fallback mechanisms gracefully, and intelligently caches results to ensure instant playback without dead links or buffering.
What's Unique:
Unlike typical streaming sites that rely on a single fragile video host, Yorumi operates on a resilient, multi-provider scraping architecture. It acts as a smart aggregator—if one source goes down, the app automatically fails over to the next best provider without the user ever noticing. Combined with its sleek, ad-free UI and deep library integration, Yorumi offers a premium, uninterrupted entertainment experience that traditional web streaming simply can't match.

name: NymStorm
tagline: Anonymous async brainstorming for better team decisions
features_and_description:
NymStorm is an anonymous, asynchronous brainstorming platform built to strip hierarchy out of team ideation. Instead of live meetings where the loudest voice or highest title wins, NymStorm runs timed sprints where every contributor submits ideas under a randomly assigned alias — no names, no job titles, no seniority in sight.
Each sprint starts with a "How might we…" prompt. Contributors submit ideas on their own time, build directly on each other's threads, and occasionally get pushed past the obvious answer by system-injected wildcard prompts. When the sprint closes, voting happens one idea at a time, completely blind — ranked purely on what's written, never on who wrote it.
Once results are locked in, a facilitator-triggered reveal finally shows who said what — so recognition comes after the idea earns it, not before. The result: quieter voices get an equal shot, groupthink has less room to take over, and the ideas that survive are the ones that actually deserve to.

name: Burger Tower
tagline: A casual one-tap burger-stacking game. Stack high. Aim low.
features_and_description:
Tap to stack the perfect burger tower. Time your drops, chase the perfect stack
Burger Tower is a one-tap stacking game about building the tallest, sloppiest,
most gravity-defying burger you can. The premise is simple: tap to drop each
sliding ingredient onto the stack. Mastering it is anything but.
Every patty, slice of cheese, leaf of lettuce, ring of onion and wobbly tomato
slides back and forth across the screen. Tap at the right moment to drop it.
Land it dead-center for a PERFECT and keep your full width — miss, and the
overhang gets sliced clean off, leaving you a little less to build on. Keep
slicing and your tower narrows to a toothpick. Keep nailing Perfects and you
build a clean, towering, impossibly tall burger.
And the game never lets up. The ingredients slide faster the higher you climb,
the margin for error shrinks, and gravity is always waiting for one sloppy tap.
How high can you stack before it all comes tumbling down?
ONE-TAP, PICK-UP-AND-PLAY
No complicated controls, no tutorials to sit through. One tap to drop, that's
the whole game. Perfect for a quick round on the bus, in a queue, or whenever
you've got thirty seconds to kill.
CHASE THE PERFECT STACK
Centered drops trigger Perfects, build combos, and keep your tower wide.
String them together and watch your stack climb clean and tall. It's a test of
timing, rhythm, and nerve.
CLIMB THE RANKS
Start at the bottom as a lowly Dishwasher and work your way up through the
kitchen hierarchy all the way to Burger Architect. Every great tower earns its
maker a promotion.
TRACK YOUR STATS
A running ingredient tally counts everything you stack, and a gloriously
pointless calorie counter tots up just how monstrous your creation has become.
Your best score and lifetime stats are saved right on your device.
PLAYS ANYWHERE
Fully offline, portrait orientation, designed for short bursts. No account, no
sign-up, no internet required. Just open it and stack.
FEATURES
- One-tap, pick-up-and-play stacking gameplay
- Perfect-drop precision for combos and clean towers
- Ever-increasing speed and difficulty the higher you go
- Climb the ranks from Dishwasher to Burger Architect
- A running ingredient tally and a wonderfully silly calorie counter
- Best score and lifetime stats saved on your device
- Plays fully offline, in portrait, in short bursts
- No account or sign-up required
Whether you're a casual snacker looking to pass a few minutes or a high-score
fiend hunting that flawless run, Burger Tower serves up addictive, satisfying,
one-more-go gameplay.
Stack high. Aim low. Build the burger of your dreams.

- Swipe up to jump over fallen logs and leap clear of animals.
- Scoop up gold along the way to grow your haul.

FEATURES
- True 3D descent — a behind-the-boulder chase camera barreling downhill through a living jungle.
- One-thumb controls anyone can pick up in seconds, with depth to master.
- Choose your boulder — roll as Granite, Sandstone, Mossrock, Obsidian, or the golden Idol.
- Dodge or be stopped — trees and boulders block your lane, logs trip you up, and hidden bumps send you flying.

- Chase your best — beat your top distance and your biggest gold haul.
- Play anywhere — no account, no internet required. Just roll.
Lush jungle, wild hillsides, and the simple, addictive thrill of a stone that simply will. not. stop.
Can you keep the boulder rolling?

Drivers like me have to guess, drive around, and we’ll only get the info once we get there. For cyclists, they also have difficulty in looking for bicycle friendly parking spaces.
-----------

As a driver and commuter myself, I’m surprised that nothing has solved this problem locally!
I was inspired by Metro Fuel Tracker because they provide real-time fuel price updates.
I thought, what if we could do the same thing, but for real-time parking???
𝐇𝐨𝐰 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐲 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐭:
Wtih a cheap electrostatic whiteboard that I plastered to my condo wall, a few brain dump ideas scribbled on the said whiteboard, and a long weekend to build an app and I can’t go outside because of a sprained ankle….
𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐲 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐛𝐨𝐫𝐧.
-----------
𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐲 𝐚𝐢𝐦𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐨 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮:

- Saved parking spots for your go-to locations
- Operator tools for parking owners to manage their listings

𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭’𝐬 𝐧𝐞𝐱𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐲?

𝐁𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐮𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐲
Parky is designed to be powered by real people: drivers, commuters, cyclists, and operators, helping each other navigate one of the most frustrating parts of city life.

Parky only works if people (like you!) can contribute.
