Prefixed tables (page_builder_* / pb_[key])
Its own auth guard — never touches yours
Admin UI is an opt-in Filament plugin
Routes defer to your app's — it never claims /
Everything is overridable: connection, table names, guard, routes, models.
Nothing leaves your server. No SaaS. No per-seat pricing. No lock-in. MIT-licensed and yours.
What's inside
🧩 Pages Components
— GrapesJS visual builder + a real UI kit (cards, modals, drawers, tabs, forms, tables). Per-page CSS/JS, SEO, cached public routes, gated image uploads. Management pages bundle an Add form, a live table, and per-row Edit/Delete in one pattern.
🗄️ Collections
— Define models into real database tables with typed fields, schema sync, and an instant REST API (filter, sort, search, paginate, ?expand=* to resolve relations). Or map an existing table as a read-only virtual collection.
⚡ Flows
— An n8n-style visual canvas: CRUD, HTTP, AI, conditions, set-state, email, and page-action nodes, with true/false branches, sub-flows, and auto-layout.
ƒ Functions States
— Reusable logic (expression, callable, or PHP) plus a persistent, app-wide reactive store that components bind to and flows update live.
🔐 Auth Permissions
— Your app's own users, roles, and permissions. Password / SSO (Google, Microsoft, GitHub) / 2FA, self-registration + invites, per-page gating, row- and field-level security. Public sites can skip it entirely.
✉️ Email
— Isolated SMTP transport + a send_email node that turns any page into a templated email.
✦ AI generation
— Describe an app, review a validated plan, apply it. A floating chat follows you across the admin to refine what you've built. Powered by -
https://www.appbuildersph.com/apps/ai-openrouter-gateway
.
What you can build
Internal CRUD tool
— collections + management pages, gated by role with row-level access.
Lead-capture site
— a public form that writes to a collection and emails a confirmation.
Reactive dashboard
— components bound to live state, no page reloads.
Marketing site
— design freely, publish to a cached route.

No more hardcoded prompts or redeploys to change a model.
Why?
No hardcoded prompts. Prompt, variables, model, and params live in the database and the admin UI — not your source tree.
Tune in production, instantly. Edit and save; the next call uses it. Every save mints a new version you can roll back to.
Test across models in seconds. Pick any model from the live catalog, hit Test, and compare output, tokens, latency, and cost — then promote the better or cheaper one.
One use case, every caller. Invoke it from any PHP service and any external app or language over HTTPS — one source of truth, reused across platforms.
Spend you can see and cap. Per-call cost / token / latency telemetry, plus per-integration rate limits and daily budgets.

name: Good Word
tagline: Hire Workers You Can Trust
features_and_description:
Hello everyone,
I just want to share this online platform I created called Good Word. It's an online platform for odd jobs workers. By odd jobs meaning are the people we hire for everyday or on call work basis around the house — house cleaning, home repairs, labandera, etc. Pwede din yung mga nag hahanap ng reliable coaches for their sports, or mechanics for your cars incase you happen to run into a car malfunction, mga ganun.
The plan is to gather all these listings on a vouch-based website.
How it works:
It's built around vouching. Someone posts a worker they've personally hired and leaves a short vouch — what the job was, how it went, and a quick rating. Other people who've worked with that same person can add their own vouch too. So instead of an anonymous list of strangers, every worker shows up with real people standing behind them. When you need to hire someone, you just browse by the kind of work, see who's already trusted, and reach out.
Why?
It's hard to find workers you can actually trust — which is exactly why vouching is the way. You're seeing people that real, identifiable folks are willing to back.
We all know someone who does great work for these jobs, but we don't all know each other. This bridges that gap — it turns "I know a good person for that" into something you can easily pass on. Word of mouth is still the best marketing; this just makes it easier to share.
Honest, hardworking people in these trades deserve more attention. This helps the right workers get noticed for the quality they bring.
Just to be clear — this isn't a social media app, and it's not trying to replace any networking site. It's a straightforward listing where people connect with the right worker. Nothing more complicated than that.
So instead of posting here on FB asking for recos, you can go directly here and contact the people you need.

WHY FAMILIES CHOOSE GENTLEWATCH

Transparent, not sneaky. A soft care indicator stays visible on the page, so the person always knows GentleWatch is there. Trust is the whole point.
Private by design. There's no account and no server. Your data stays on your computer. The only time GentleWatch reaches the internet is to check a Premium license key, and even then it sends nothing but the key — no browsing history, no names, nothing.
Made for neurodivergent users. Calm colors, large readable type, slow motion, and the same predictable layout every day, because consistency is a kindness.
WHAT GENTLEWATCH DOES
- Tracks time across every tab and window, with idle detection so the clock pauses when no one is there.
- Sorts time into YouTube, social media, games, and everything else.
- Shows the same calm screen with your words when a site is off-limits, never a browser error page.
- Sets daily limits with gentle reminders and soft 10, 5, and 1 minute countdowns.
- Lets a caregiver PIN grant a little more time when it's needed.
- Keeps a private caregiver dashboard, behind a PIN, with the day's report: total time, time per site, a timeline, top videos with repeat counts, and any gentle nudges shown.

Caregivers can flag keywords in video titles and choose a soft response, from a quiet note in the summary to a calm screen. Social time is counted whether the person is logged in or not. Messages and private content are never read.
FREE AND PREMIUM
The free plan keeps the heart of GentleWatch: time tracking, the care indicator, a daily limit with gentle reminders, both adult and child profiles, the calm off-limits screen, sessions, and today's summary.
A one-time Premium unlock adds custom loving messages in your own words, keyword flags, comfort lists, quiet hours, behavior care nudges, and a full 60-day history with export for doctors or therapists. Anything you set up is never deleted, and it returns the moment Premium is active.
GentleWatch is made with love, for real families.

“Strong states prevent crises quietly, not loudly.”

For many Filipino workers, the journey abroad begins with hope. A signed contract. A packed suitcase. A family waiting for good news. A dream carried across airports, borders, and unfamiliar homes.

Every year, nearly two million Filipinos leave the country to work overseas. Yet the same painful stories return: abuse, contract substitution, unpaid wages, confiscated documents, emergency rescues, unexplained deaths, and families left searching for answers.
The government often responds with investigations, repatriation, legal assistance, and emergency support. These actions matter. But too often, they arrive after the damage has already been done.
The issue is not lack of compassion.
The issue is architecture.
Information is scattered. Monitoring is fragmented. Enforcement usually begins only after a complaint becomes loud enough, a story becomes public enough, or a worker’s suffering becomes impossible to ignore.
But before every crisis, there are signals.
A recruiter begins cutting corners. A contract starts changing. A worker becomes isolated. Financial pressure builds. Communication weakens. Risk begins quietly.
And because the system was not built to detect these signals early, the country keeps rescuing workers it should have protected sooner.
That is why
Power Mims Corporation
developed
TARAKABAYAN
.
TARAKABAYAN is not just another platform. It is a preventive protection system for the overseas Filipino journey.
It was built on one clear belief: Filipino workers deserve protection before the problem happens, not after.
Not another hotline that waits for fear.
Not another memo after a tragedy.
Not another rescue operation after abuse.
TARAKABAYAN
is the worker’s pocket guardian. It is designed to keep the Filipino abroad informed, connected, visible, and protected across the full migration arc, from preparation to deployment, employment, return, and reintegration.
Its purpose is simple but powerful: detect risk early, trigger accountability faster, and help prevent harm before it becomes a crisis.
When
TARAKABAYAN
reaches full scale, success will not be measured by louder enforcement or more rescue flights.
Success will be measured by what never happens.
The worker never abused.
The contract never substituted.
The emergency never triggered.
The family never forced to grieve.
The nation never forced to explain why protection came too late.
That is the future
TARAKABAYAN
is built for.
Developed by
Power Mims Corporation
,
TARAKABAYAN
carries one mission forward:

name: GIS.ph
tagline: Philippine geography, API-first
features_and_description:
The problem
Philippine geographic boundary data (province → barangay level) is scattered across government portals and community shapefile dumps, with inconsistent formats and unclear licensing.
The solution
gis.ph wraps it in a simple REST API — api.gis.ph/v1/barangays style endpoints, Bearer token auth, SDKs/docs for JS, Python, PHP.
What's unique
Granularity (down to 42,000+ barangays) and productization — versioned API, deprecation schedules, tiered pricing/SLA — rather than unique underlying data. The boundaries likely still trace back to PSA/NAMRIA/OSM sources like everyone else; the differentiator is convenience, not exclusivity.
gis.ph isn't stopping at boundary lookups — the roadmap builds toward Census 2020 socio-economic layers, spatial clustering, and logistics routing, then opens into a public layer marketplace with IoT integration for smart cities. The endgame is genuinely exciting: an AI Spatial Co-pilot that lets you query Philippine geography in plain language and get predictive growth modeling back. It's an ambitious multi-year build though — they're currently just wrapping up Phase 1 (the core API), so the flashier stuff is still on the horizon.
